old.name: AvailableChain.Block.root_injective
old.source:
theorem root_injective : Function.Injective Block.root := by
  intro B
  induction B with
  | genesis =>
    intro C h
    cases C with
    | genesis => rfl
    | node q t y => exact absurd h.symm (root_ne_genesis_of_node q t y)
  | node p s x ih =>
    intro C h
    cases C with
    | genesis => exact absurd h (root_ne_genesis_of_node p s x)
    | node q t y =>
      simp only [root, nodeRoot, BlockId.mk.injEq, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨hpq, hst⟩ := epair_inj h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := epair_inj hst
      rw [ih (BlockId.ext hpq)]

end Block

def RFrame : Prop := ∀ i x, x ∈ rho.honest →
  let st := storeAt p c E rho i x
  (∀ s b raw support P rows, parentFG st b = some P →
    blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true →
    (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg = Window.on_block p p.K_W st.fg (fgBlock P b rows)) ∧
  ((∀ f : GridCO.State p.n → GridCO.State p.n, (onView f st).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ s k b, (admitHead p st s k b).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ a, (admitRow p st a).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ t, (FGSA.clock p st t).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ s b raw support rows,
      (parentFG st b = none ∨
        ∃ P, parentFG st b = some P ∧ blockAccepted p st s b P rows = false) →
      (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ o, o.decode = none → (FGSA.process p st o).fg = st.fg)) ∧
  (FGSA.controls p (FGSA.reconcile st) = FGSA.controls p st ∧
    ∀ X, domainR p (FGSA.reconcile st) X = domainR p st X) ∧
  (MetaInv p st ∧
    (∀ s, proposalsAt st s = st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ b raw sup _) => if b.slot = s then some (raw, sup) else none
      | _ => none)) ∧
    (∀ H, chainWireRows st H = (st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ b _ _ rows) => if Block.preceq b H then some rows else none
      | _ => none)).flatten) ∧
    (blockWireRows st = (st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ _ _ _ rows) => some rows
      | _ => none)).flatten) ∧
    (∀ s, voterBlocks p st s = st.fg.TF.filter (fun B =>
      decide (GridCO.stampBlock st.base (eraseFG B) < SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)) ||
      decide (∃ P ∈ st.fg.TF, P.slot = s ∧ FGBlock.Preceq B P))) ∧
    (∀ s, headVotes p st s =
      (((GridCO.votesAt st.base (s - 1)).filter (fun o =>
        decide (GridCO.stampVote st.base o < SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)))) ++
        (((proposalsAt st s).flatMap (fun row => row.1.map baseVote)).filter
          (fun o => GridCO.headLabel? o == some (s - 1)))).eraseDups) ∧
    (∀ s, headSupport p st s =
      (((GridCO.votesAt st.base (s - 1)).filter (fun o =>
        GridCO.resolvedBefore (FGSA.actView st) o (SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)))) ++
        (((proposalsAt st s).flatMap (fun row => row.2.map baseVote)).filter (fun o =>
          GridCO.headLabel? o == some (s - 1) && match GridCO.headTarget? o with
          | some h => GridCO.blockKnown st.base h && decide (h.slot ≤ s - 1)
          | none => false))).eraseDups) ∧
    (∀ H, proposalRows p st H =
      match fgBlockOf st H with
      | none => []
      | some P =>
          (st.rowPool ++ blockWireRows st).eraseDups.filter (fun a =>
            Window.rowValidW (parentFoldState p (st.slot p) P) a &&
              !decide (a ∈ chainWireRows st H))) ∧
    (V2.D.NoRestart rho → ∀ j, i ≤ j → j ≤ rho.events.length →
      let st' := storeAt p c E rho j x
      st.proposals <+: st'.proposals ∧ st.rowPool <+: st'.rowPool ∧
      st.base.blockStamp <+: st'.base.blockStamp ∧ st.base.voteStamp <+: st'.base.voteStamp))

  let st := storeAt p c E rho i x
  (∀ s b raw support P rows, parentFG st b = some P →
    blockAccepted p st s b raw support P rows = true →
    (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg = Window.on_block p p.K_W st.fg (fgBlock P b rows)) ∧
  ((∀ f : GridCO.State p.n → GridCO.State p.n, (onView f st).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ s k b, (admitHead p st s k b).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ a, (admitRow p st a).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ t, (FGSA.clock p st t).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ s b raw support rows,
      (parentFG st b = none ∨
        ∃ P, parentFG st b = some P ∧ blockAccepted p st s b raw support P rows = false) →
      (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg = st.fg) ∧
    (∀ o, o.decode = none → (FGSA.process p st o).fg = st.fg)) ∧
  (FGSA.controls p (FGSA.reconcile st) = FGSA.controls p st ∧
    ∀ X, domainR p (FGSA.reconcile st) X = domainR p st X) ∧
  (MetaInv p st ∧
    (∀ s, proposalsAt st s = st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ b raw sup _) => if b.slot = s then some (raw, sup) else none
      | _ => none)) ∧
    (∀ H, chainWireRows st H = (st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ b _ _ rows) => if Block.preceq b H then some rows else none
      | _ => none)).flatten) ∧
    (blockWireRows st = (st.proposals.filterMap (fun o => match o.decode with
      | some (.block _ _ _ _ rows) => some rows
      | _ => none)).flatten) ∧
    (∀ s, voterBlocks p st s = st.fg.TF.filter (fun B =>
      decide (GridCO.stampBlock st.base (eraseFG B) < SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)) ||
      decide (∃ P ∈ st.fg.TF, P.slot = s ∧ FGBlock.Preceq B P))) ∧
    (∀ s, headVotes p st s =
      (((GridCO.votesAt st.base (s - 1)).filter (fun o =>
        decide (GridCO.stampVote st.base o < SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)))) ++
        (((proposalsAt st s).flatMap (fun row => row.1.map baseVote)).filter
          (fun o => GridCO.headLabel? o == some (s - 1)))).eraseDups) ∧
    (∀ s, headSupport p st s =
      (((GridCO.votesAt st.base (s - 1)).filter (fun o =>
        GridCO.resolvedBefore (FGSA.actView st) o (SA.freezeTime p.toParams (s - 1)))) ++
        (((proposalsAt st s).flatMap (fun row => row.2.map baseVote)).filter (fun o =>
          GridCO.headLabel? o == some (s - 1) && match GridCO.headTarget? o with
          | some h => GridCO.blockKnown st.base h && decide (h.slot ≤ s - 1)
          | none => false))).eraseDups) ∧
    (∀ H, proposalRows p st H =
      match fgBlockOf st H with
      | none => []
      | some P =>
          (st.rowPool ++ blockWireRows st).eraseDups.filter (fun a =>
            Window.rowValidW (parentFoldState p (st.slot p) P) a &&
              !decide (a ∈ chainWireRows st H))) ∧
    (V2.D.NoRestart rho → ∀ j, i ≤ j → j ≤ rho.events.length →
      let st' := storeAt p c E rho j x
      st.proposals <+: st'.proposals ∧ st.rowPool <+: st'.rowPool ∧
      st.base.blockStamp <+: st'.base.blockStamp ∧ st.base.voteStamp <+: st'.base.voteStamp))

def Ready_W (i : Nat) (x : V) (W : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (t : Time) : Prop :=
  ∃ o s raw support rows P,
    rho.events[i]? = some (.deliver x o t) ∧
    (toWire p o).decode = some (.block s (eraseFG W) raw support rows) ∧
    FGSA.parentFG (storeAt p c E rho i x) (eraseFG W) = some P ∧
    FGSA.blockAccepted p (storeAt p c E rho i x) s (eraseFG W) P rows = true ∧
    FGSA.fgBlock P (eraseFG W) rows = W

def ReceiptCoverageStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ {p : Params} {In V : Type} [DecidableEq V] {c : AppCodec In}
    (E : Generic.Env V) (rho : V2.D.Run V (fgsa p c))
    (dl : Time → Time) (cut D : Time) (first : Nat) (x : V) (B : Block)
    (required : Obj p → Time → Prop) (paths : Block → Time → Prop),
    E.Δ = p.Δ → V2.D.ExecutionValid E rho → V2.D.NoRestart rho → x ∈ rho.honest →
    ReceiptCoveragePremises E rho dl cut D first x B required paths →
    let st := (V2.D.Run.stateBeforeTime E rho D x).st
    ((Block.Preceq B (eraseFG st.fg.F) ∧
      Block.Preceq B st.base.stableRecord ∧
      (∀ s, 0 < s → Block.Preceq B (headVote p st s)) ∧
      (∀ raw sup, Block.Preceq B (getHead p st raw sup)) ∧
      Block.Preceq B (fgHead p st) ∧
      (∀ lease ∈ st.base.obligations, Block.Compatible B lease.1)) ∨
     (Block.Preceq (eraseFG st.fg.F) B ∧
      (∀ o t s b raw sup rows, required o t →
        (toWire p o).decode = some (.block s b raw sup rows) →
        ∃ Y ∈ (V2.D.Run.stateBeforeTime E rho (dl t) x).st.fg.TF, eraseFG Y = b) ∧
      (∀ K d, paths K d → ∀ b, Block.Preceq b K →
        ∃ Y ∈ (V2.D.Run.stateBeforeTime E rho d x).st.fg.TF, eraseFG Y = b))) ∧
    (∀ o t s a K, required o t → (toWire p o).decode = some (.vote s a K) →

theorem proposal_handle_in_scope (E : Generic.Env V) (rho : V2.D.Run V (fgsa p c))
    (o : Obj p) (s : Slot) (b : Block)
    (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (ho : o = ofWire p ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩)
    (j : Nat) (w : V) (t : Time) (hh : V2.D.Run.handlesAt E rho j w o t) :
    RootBlockInRun p c E rho b := by
  obtain ⟨parent, hevent, hcall⟩ := hh
  have hd : (toWire p o).decode = some (.block s b raw support rows) := by
    rw [ho]
    rfl
  have hp := proposal_handlesS_direct _ parent o s b raw support rows hd hcall
  subst parent
  refine ⟨b, Or.inl ⟨w, o, t, raw, support, rows, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact List.mem_of_getElem? hevent
  · rw [ho]
    rfl
  · cases b <;> simp [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq]

new.source:
theorem proposal_handlesS_direct (st : State p.n) (parent o : Obj p)
    (s : Slot) (b : Block) (raw sup : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (hd : (toWire p o).decode = some (.block s b raw sup rows))
    (hh : handlesS p st parent o) : parent = o := by
  rcases hh with h | h
  · exact h
  · cases hp : (toWire p parent).decode with
    | none => simp only [hp] at h
    | some m =>
      cases m with
      | vote r i B => simp only [hp] at h
      | row i body => simp only [hp] at h
      | block r B raw' sup' rows' =>
        rw [hp] at h
        rcases h.2 with hm | hm
        · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
          rcases a with ⟨⟨(_ | _), _⟩ | _ | _, _⟩ <;> simp [toWire, ofHead, ofWire, ofAuth,
            toAuth, Wire.decode] at hd
        · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
          rcases a with ⟨⟨(_ | _), _⟩ | _ | _, _⟩ <;> simp [toWire, ofRow, ofWire, ofAuth, toAuth,
            Wire.decode] at hd

theorem proposal_trigger_in_scope
    (E : Generic.Env V) (rho : V2.D.Run V (fgsa p c))
    (o : Obj p) (s : Slot) (b : Block)
    (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (ho : o = ofWire p ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩)
    (dl : Time → Time) (cut t : Time) (w : V)
    (hD : Gen.V2.Duty.DeliveryWithinOn E rho (fun o => ¬ isRowObject o) dl cut)
    (hT : Gen.V2.Duty.Trigger E rho o t) (hw : w ∈ rho.honest)
    (hcut : dl t ≤ cut)
    (hNX : (fgsa p c).excludes (V2.D.Run.stateBeforeTime E rho (dl t) w) o = false) :
    RootBlockInRun p c E rho b := by
  rcases hT with ⟨v, hv, hemit⟩ | ⟨v, _, i, haccept⟩
  · have hQ : ¬ isRowObject o := by
      rw [ho]
      simp [isRowObject, ofWire]
    obtain ⟨t', _, _, j, hh⟩ := hD.broadcast v hv o hQ t hemit w hw hcut hNX
    exact proposal_handle_in_scope E rho o s b raw support rows ho j w t' hh
  · exact proposal_handle_in_scope E rho o s b raw support rows ho i v t haccept.1

private theorem birth_at_target (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (hj : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_j = (derive p K P).h)
    (hJ : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).J = (derive p K P).T_h) :
    JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) (.node P s x rs)
      (derive p K P).h (derive p K P).T_h := by
  let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
  change (derive p K B).h_j = (derive p K P).h at hj
  change (derive p K B).J = (derive p K P).T_h at hJ
  have hg := windowHeightLaws p K hK
  have hlt := hg.justified_below_height B
  change (derive p K B).h_j < (derive p K B).h at hlt
  have hh : (derive p K B).h = (derive p K P).h + 1 := by
    rcases hg.node_cases P s x rs with hn | hn
    · have he := hn.1
      change (derive p K B).h = (derive p K P).h at he
      rw [hj, he] at hlt
      exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ hlt).elim
    · exact hn.1
  refine ⟨(by intro h; cases h), rfl, rfl, hj, hJ, hh, ?_⟩
  have hnz : (certificateHeight p K B).h_j ≠ 0 := by
    change (derive p K B).h_j ≠ 0
    rw [hj]
    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (hg.one_le_h P)
  have hq := hg.justification_certificate B hnz
  change TargetQCAt p.E B (derive p K B).h_j (derive p K B).J at hq
  rw [hj, hJ] at hq
  exact hq

private theorem fold_sources (p : Params) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (w : State (Fin p.n)) :
    (rs.foldl process_row w).h = w.h ∧
    (rs.foldl process_row w).T_h = w.T_h ∧
    ∀ e ∈ (rs.foldl process_row w).W, ∃ d ∈ w.W,
      d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X ∧
      ∀ i ∈ e.Q, i ∈ d.Q ∨ ∃ a ∈ rs,
        a.signer = i ∧ a.finality_pair = some ⟨e.j, e.X.root⟩ := by
  have row (w : State (Fin p.n)) (a : Row (Fin p.n)) :
      (process_row w a).h = w.h ∧ (process_row w a).T_h = w.T_h ∧
      (process_row w a).W = w.W.map (fun e =>
        if a.finality_pair = some ⟨e.j, e.X.root⟩ then
          { e with Q := insert a.signer e.Q } else e) := by
    obtain ⟨i, pair, fp⟩ := a
    cases pair with
    | empty => simp only [process_row_def, NamedHeightPair.matchesEntry]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    | vote j X t =>
        cases t <;> simp only [process_row_def] <;> split_ifs <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  induction rs generalizing w with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, rfl, fun e he => ⟨e, he, rfl, rfl, fun _ hi => Or.inl hi⟩⟩
  | cons a rs ih =>
      obtain ⟨hh, hT, hs⟩ := ih (process_row w a)
      obtain ⟨rh, rT, rW⟩ := row w a
      refine ⟨hh.trans rh, hT.trans rT, ?_⟩
      intro e he
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hj, hX, hbits⟩ := hs e he
      rw [rW, List.mem_map] at hd
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hcd⟩ := hd
      have keys : c.j = d.j ∧ c.X.root = d.X.root := by
        split_ifs at hcd <;> subst d <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      have cX : c.X = e.X := (FGBlock.root_injective keys.2).trans hX
      have cj := keys.1.trans hj
      refine ⟨c, hc, cj, cX, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      rcases hbits i hi with hi | ⟨b, hb, hbi, hbf⟩
      · split_ifs at hcd with hm
        · subst d
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with hi | hi
          · exact Or.inr ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self, hi.symm, by simpa only [cj, cX] using hm⟩
          · exact Or.inl hi
        · subst d; exact Or.inl hi
      · exact Or.inr ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hbi, hbf⟩

private theorem node_evicted (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (e : Entry (Fin p.n)) (he : e ∈ (derive p K P).W)
    (gone : ¬ ∃ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X)
    (above : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_F < e.j) :
    (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W.length = K ∧
    ∀ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, e.j < d.j := by
  let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
  let w := certificateFolded p K B
  let f := finalizeWindow p.E w
  let d := rs.foldl (fun e a => addBit a e) e
  have ff := fold_fields rs { derive p K P with s := s }
  have dk := fold_entry rs e
  have fin := final_fields p w
  have ef := events_finality p K w
  have dw : d ∈ w.W := by
    change d ∈ (rs.foldl process_row { derive p K P with s := s }).W
    rw [ff.1]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
  have df : d ∈ f.W := by
    rw [fin.2.2.2.2, List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨dw, decide_eq_true ?_⟩
    rw [← ef.2, dk.1]
    exact above
  have cap : f.W.length ≤ K := by
    rw [fin.2.2.2.2]
    refine (List.length_filter_le _ _).trans ?_
    change (rs.foldl process_row { derive p K P with s := s }).W.length ≤ K
    rw [ff.1, List.length_map]
    exact window_capacity p K hK P
  have ord : f.W.Pairwise (fun a b => a.j < b.j ∧ FGBlock.Preceq a.X b.X) := by
    rw [fin.2.2.2.2]
    apply List.Pairwise.filter
    change (rs.foldl process_row { derive p K P with s := s }).W.Pairwise _
    rw [ff.1, List.pairwise_map]
    exact (window_ordered p K hK P).imp (fun {a b} h => by
      simpa only [(fold_entry rs a).1, (fold_entry rs a).2.1,
        (fold_entry rs b).1, (fold_entry rs b).2.1] using h)
  have fh : w.h = (derive p K P).h := ff.2.1
  have fT : w.T_h = (derive p K P).T_h := ff.2.2.1

private theorem retentionBirth_entry (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (C : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (j : Nat) (X : FGBlock (Fin p.n))
    (birth : JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) C j X) :
    (Entry.mk j X ∅) ∈ (derive p K C).W := by
  cases C with
  | genesis => exact (birth.1 rfl).elim
  | node P s x rs =>
      have hp : (derive p K P).h = j := birth.2.1
      have hcj : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_j = j := birth.2.2.2.1
      have hcX : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).J = X := birth.2.2.2.2.1
      have ht : targetQuorum p.E
          (finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))) = true := by
        rcases window_latest_pair_kept p K P s x rs with kept | crossed
        · have below := (windowHeightLaws p K hK).justified_below_height P
          change (derive p K P).h_j < (derive p K P).h at below
          rw [← kept.1, hcj, hp] at below
          exact (Nat.lt_irrefl j below).elim
        · exact crossed.2.2
      have latest : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_j =
          (finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))).h ∧
          (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).J =
          (finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))).T_h := by
        change (process_height_events p.E p.cfg K
            (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))).h_j = _ ∧
          (process_height_events p.E p.cfg K
            (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))).J = _
        rw [process_height_events_def, ite_eq_left ht]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      have hj := latest.1.symm.trans hcj
      have hX := latest.2.symm.trans hcX
      obtain ⟨_, older, appended, _, _⟩ := window_target_appended_newest p K hK P s x rs ht
      rw [hj, hX] at appended
      rw [appended]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)

      (certificateFinality p K) st) (hpar : B.parent ∈ st.TF) :
    FGStoreInvariant (fun B => projectHeight (derive p K B)) (certificateFinality p K)
      (update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B) := by
  have hTF := window_update_finality_TF p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B
  have hsub : st.TF ⊆ insert B st.TF := Finset.subset_insert B st.TF
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDF⟩ := h.Fcar
  have hne : ∃ C ∈ st.TF, FGBlock.Preceq st.F (SimplexFG.derive p.E p.cfg C).J := by
    refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
    rw [← window_J_eq p K hK, ← hDF]
    exact window_F_preceq_J p K hK D
  have hp := (window_pair_iff p K hK st hne).mp h.pair
  have hpairJ : ((update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B).h_j,
      (update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B).J) =
      lexMax p.E p.cfg st.F (insert B st.TF) := by
    rw [window_update_finality_pair, window_hj_eq p K hK, window_J_eq p K hK,
      lexMax_insert p.E p.cfg st.F st.TF B (viewRootInj_all _) hne, ← hp]
  have hFJ : FGBlock.Preceq st.F
      (update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B).J := by
    have hj := window_update_finality_pair p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B
    dsimp only at hj
    split_ifs at hj with hc
    · rw [(Prod.mk.inj hj).2]
      exact hc.1
    · rw [(Prod.mk.inj hj).2]
      exact h.FJ
  have hne' : ∃ C ∈ insert B st.TF,
      FGBlock.Preceq st.F (SimplexFG.derive p.E p.cfg C).J :=
    hne.imp (fun _ hc => ⟨hsub hc.1, hc.2⟩)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hTF]
    intro C hC
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hC with rfl | hC
    · exact hsub hpar
    · exact hsub (h.closed C hC)
  · rw [hTF]
    exact hsub h.gen
  · rw [hTF]
    rcases window_update_finality_F_cases p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B with
      hF | ⟨_, hmem, _, hF⟩
    · rw [hF]
      exact hsub h.Fmem
    · rw [hF]
      exact hmem
  · have hm : st.h_max = frontier p.E p.cfg st.TF := by
      simpa only [projectHeight_def, window_height_eq p K hK, SimplexFG.frontier, ← hOf_eq]
        using h.hmax

      (show (update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B).h_max =
        frontier p.E p.cfg (insert B st.TF) by
          rw [window_update_finality_h_max, window_height_eq p K hK,
            frontier_insert, ← hm]
          rfl)
  · have hnew : ∃ C ∈ (update_finality p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B).TF,

          (SimplexFG.derive p.E p.cfg C).J := by
      obtain ⟨C, hC, _, heq, _⟩ := lexMax_spec p.E p.cfg st.F _ (viewRootInj_all _) hne'
      refine ⟨C, hTF ▸ hC, ?_⟩
      have hj := (Prod.mk.inj (hpairJ.trans heq)).2
      rw [← hj]
      rcases window_update_finality_F_cases p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B with

    rcases window_update_finality_F_cases p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B with
      hF | ⟨hadv, _, hJ, hF⟩
    · rw [hF]
      exact hpairJ
    · rw [hF, hpairJ]
      apply (lexMax_of_advance p.E p.cfg st.F _ _ (viewRootInj_all _) hne' hadv ?_).symm
      rw [← hpairJ]
      exact hJ
  · rcases window_update_finality_F_cases p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B with
      hF | ⟨_, _, hJ, hF⟩
    · rw [hF]
      exact hFJ
    · rw [hF]
      exact hJ
  · rw [hTF]
    rcases window_update_finality_F_cases p K { st with TF := insert B st.TF } B with
      hF | ⟨_, _, _, hF⟩
    · rw [hF]
      exact ⟨D, hsub hD, hDF⟩
    · rw [hF]
      exact ⟨B, Finset.mem_insert_self B st.TF, rfl⟩

theorem window_bit_add_of_row (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (e d : Entry (Fin p.n)) (he : e ∈ (derive p K P).W)
    (hd : d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W)
    (hj : d.j = e.j) (hX : d.X = e.X)
    (a : Row (Fin p.n)) (ha : a ∈ rs)
    (hpair : a.finality_pair = some ⟨e.j, e.X.root⟩) : a.signer ∈ d.Q := by
  have ff := livenessFold_fields rs { derive p K P with s := s }
  have below : d.j < (derive p K P).h := by
    rw [hj]
    exact (window_bounds p K hK P e he).2.1.trans_lt
      ((windowHeightLaws p K hK).justified_below_height P)
  have hm := livenessEvents_old p.E p.cfg K (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))
    d hd (by
      change d.j < (rs.foldl process_row { derive p K P with s := s }).h
      rw [ff.2]
      exact below)
  change d ∈ (rs.foldl process_row { derive p K P with s := s }).W at hm
  rw [ff.1, List.mem_map] at hm
  obtain ⟨c, _, hc⟩ := hm
  have fe := livenessFold_entry rs c
  have cj : c.j = e.j := fe.1.symm.trans ((congrArg Entry.j hc).trans hj)
  have cX : c.X = e.X := fe.2.1.symm.trans ((congrArg Entry.X hc).trans hX)
  rw [← hc]
  exact (fe.2.2 a.signer).mpr (Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl, by simpa only [cj, cX] using hpair⟩)

theorem window_entry_history (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (A B : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (hAB : FGBlock.Preceq A B)
    (e : Entry (Fin p.n)) (he : e ∈ (derive p K A).W) :
    (∃ d ∈ (derive p K B).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X ∧ e.Q ⊆ d.Q) ∨
    ((¬ ∃ d ∈ (derive p K B).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X) ∧
      e.j ≤ (derive p K B).h_F ∧ FGBlock.Preceq e.X (derive p K B).F) ∨
    ((¬ ∃ d ∈ (derive p K B).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X) ∧
      ¬ (e.j ≤ (derive p K B).h_F ∧ FGBlock.Preceq e.X (derive p K B).F) ∧
      (derive p K B).h_F < e.j ∧
      ∃ P s x rs, FGBlock.Preceq A P ∧ FGBlock.Preceq (.node P s x rs) B ∧
        (∃ d ∈ (derive p K P).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X) ∧
        (¬ ∃ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X) ∧
        (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W.length = K ∧
        ∃ C, FGBlock.Preceq C P ∧
          JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) C e.j e.X ∧
          ∀ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, e.j < d.j ∧
            ∃ D, StrictPrefix C D ∧ FGBlock.Preceq D (.node P s x rs) ∧
              JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) D d.j d.X) := by
  by_cases present : ∃ d ∈ (derive p K B).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hj, hX⟩ := present
    exact Or.inl ⟨d, hd, hj, hX,
      window_bit_retained p K hK A B hAB e d he hd hj.symm hX.symm⟩
  · by_cases covered : e.j ≤ (derive p K B).h_F ∧ FGBlock.Preceq e.X (derive p K B).F
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨present, covered⟩)
    · have above := window_evicted_above_hF p K hK A B hAB e he present covered

      obtain ⟨d, hd, hj, hX⟩ := hp

        exact (window_hF_mono p K hK _ _ hPB).trans_lt above

theorem window_entry_origin (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (B : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (e : Entry (Fin p.n))
    (he : e ∈ (derive p K B).W) : EntryOriginAt p K B e := by
  induction B generalizing e with
  | genesis => exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
  | node P s x rs ih =>
      let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
      let w := certificateFolded p K B
      let f := finalizeWindow p.E w
      have hf : f.h = w.h ∧ f.T_h = w.T_h ∧ f.W ⊆ w.W := by
        dsimp only [f]
        rw [finalizeWindow_def]
        cases greatestReady p.E w <;> simp
      have ff := fold_sources p rs { derive p K P with s := s }
      have fh : f.h = (derive p K P).h := hf.1.trans ff.1
      have fT : f.T_h = (derive p K P).T_h := hf.2.1.trans ff.2.1
      have old (d : Entry (Fin p.n)) (hd : d ∈ f.W) : EntryOriginAt p K B d := by
        obtain ⟨C, hC, hb, hw⟩ := prefinal_of_parent p K P s x rs ih d (hf.2.2 hd)
        exact ⟨C, hC.1, hb, hw⟩
      change e ∈ (process_height_events p.E p.cfg K w).W at he
      rw [process_height_events_def] at he
      change e ∈ (if targetQuorum p.E f then
        advance_height { f with
          J := f.T_h
          h_j := f.h
          W := (f.W ++ [Entry.mk f.h f.T_h ∅]).drop ((f.W ++ [Entry.mk f.h f.T_h ∅]).length - K) }
        else if progReady p.E p.cfg f then advance_height f else f).W at he
      split_ifs at he with ht
      · rcases List.mem_append.mp (List.mem_of_mem_drop he) with he | he
        · exact old e he
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
          have hnew : derive p K B = advance_height { f with
              J := f.T_h, h_j := f.h,
              W := (f.W ++ [Entry.mk f.h f.T_h ∅]).drop
                ((f.W ++ [Entry.mk f.h f.T_h ∅]).length - K) } := by
            change process_height_events p.E p.cfg K w = _
            rw [process_height_events_def, ite_eq_left ht]
          refine ⟨B, preceq_refl _, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [fh, fT]
            apply birth_at_target p K hK P s x rs
            · rw [hnew]; exact fh
            · rw [hnew]; exact fT
          · intro i hi; exact (Finset.notMem_empty i hi).elim
      · exact old e he
      · exact old e he

theorem window_evicted_has_K_newer (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (e : Entry (Fin p.n)) (he : e ∈ (derive p K P).W)
    (gone : ¬ ∃ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, d.j = e.j ∧ d.X = e.X)
    (above : (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_F < e.j) :
    (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W.length = K ∧
    ∃ C, FGBlock.Preceq C P ∧
      JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) C e.j e.X ∧
      ∀ d ∈ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).W, e.j < d.j ∧
        ∃ D, StrictPrefix C D ∧ FGBlock.Preceq D (.node P s x rs) ∧
          JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K) D d.j d.X := by
  obtain ⟨hl, hn⟩ := node_evicted p K hK P s x rs e he gone above
  obtain ⟨C, hc, hb, _⟩ := window_entry_origin p K hK P e he
  refine ⟨hl, C, hc, hb, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hbirth, _⟩ := window_entry_origin p K hK (.node P s x rs) d hd
  have hlt := hn d hd
  have heights : (certificateHeight p K C).h < (certificateHeight p K D).h := by
    rw [hb.2.2.2.2.2.1, hbirth.2.2.2.2.2.1]
    exact Nat.succ_lt_succ hlt
  have hCD : FGBlock.Preceq C D := by

theorem window_exact_row_no_missing_effect (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (B : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (y : Nat) (U : FGBlock (Fin p.n))
    (d : Entry (Fin p.n)) (hd : d ∈ (derive p K B).W)
    (hj : d.j = y) (hX : d.X = U)
    (valid : ∀ P s x rs, FGBlock.Preceq (.node P s x rs) B → ∀ a ∈ rs,
      (RowBody.ofRow a).valid = true ∧ r6w (derive p K P) a = true)
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row (Fin p.n)))
    (hCB : FGBlock.Preceq (.node P s x rs) B)
    (a : Row (Fin p.n)) (ha : a ∈ rs)
    (hpair : a.finality_pair = some ⟨y, U.root⟩) : a.signer ∈ d.Q := by
  obtain ⟨hr3, hr6⟩ := valid P s x rs hCB a ha
  change (RowBody.mk a.height_pair a.finality_pair).valid = true at hr3
  have below : y < (derive p K P).h := by
    cases hp : a.height_pair with
    | empty =>
        rw [hp] at hr3
        change false = true at hr3
        contradiction
    | vote h T t =>
        rw [hp, hpair] at hr3
        change (decide (1 ≤ h) && decide (y < h)) = true at hr3
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hr3
        have hf := hr3.2
        rw [r6w_def] at hr6
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true] at hr6
        rcases hr6 with hm | hs
        · have hm' : h = (derive p K P).h := by
            simp only [heightMatch_def, hp, NamedHeightPair.matchesEntry,
              decide_eq_true_eq] at hm
            exact hm.1
          exact hm' ▸ hf
        · have hs' : h < (derive p K P).h := by
            simp only [staleUseful_def, hp, hpair, Bool.and_eq_true,
              decide_eq_true_eq] at hs
            exact hs.1.2
          exact hf.trans hs'
  obtain ⟨C, hC, birth, _⟩ := window_entry_origin p K hK B d hd
  have hCP : FGBlock.Preceq C P := by
    cases C with
    | genesis => exact (birth.1 rfl).elim
    | node R t z rows =>
        have hb : (derive p K R).h = y := birth.2.1.trans hj
        have ne : FGBlock.node P s x rs ≠ .node R t z rows := by
          intro eq
          have ep : P = R := (FGBlock.node.inj eq).1
          rw [ep, hb] at below
          exact (Nat.lt_irrefl y) below
        rcases preceq_total_of_common hCB hC with before | after
        · have hPR := preceq_trans (preceq_parent_node P s x rs)
            (preceq_parent_of_preceq_node before ne)
          have hm := (windowHeightLaws p K hK).h_mono hPR
          change (derive p K P).h ≤ (derive p K R).h at hm
          rw [hb] at hm
          exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hm below).elim
        · exact preceq_parent_of_preceq_node after (Ne.symm ne)
  have born := retentionBirth_entry p K hK C d.j d.X birth
  have hPB := preceq_trans (preceq_parent_node P s x rs) hCB
  obtain ⟨e, he, hej, heX, _, _⟩ := window_retained_bits_mono p K hK C P B
    hCP hPB ⟨d.j, d.X, ∅⟩ d born hd rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcj, hcX, _, _⟩ := window_retained_bits_mono p K hK P
    (.node P s x rs) B (preceq_parent_node P s x rs) hCB e d he hd hej.symm heX.symm
  have bit := window_bit_add_of_row p K hK P s x rs e c he hc hcj hcX a ha
    (by simpa only [hej, heX, hj, hX] using hpair)
  exact window_bit_retained p K hK (.node P s x rs) B hCB c d hc hd
    (hcj.trans hej) (hcX.trans heX) bit

theorem window_final_birth (p : Params) (K : Nat) (hK : 2 ≤ K)
    (B : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (hnz : (derive p K B).h_F ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C, FGBlock.Preceq C B ∧ JustificationBirth p.E (certificateHeight p K)
      C (derive p K B).h_F (derive p K B).F := by
  induction B with
  | genesis => exact (hnz rfl).elim
  | node P s x rs ih =>
      let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
      let w := certificateFolded p K B
      have ff := fold_fields rs { derive p K P with s := s }
      have ef := events_finality p K w
      change (derive p K B).F = _ ∧ (derive p K B).h_F = _ at ef
      rw [ef.2] at hnz
      rw [ef.1, ef.2]
      cases hg : greatestReady p.E w with

      e.j ≤ (derive p K (.node P s x rs)).h_F := by

    (ht : targetQuorum p.E
      (finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K (.node P s x rs))) = true) :
    let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
    let f := finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K B)
    let new : Entry (Fin p.n) := ⟨f.h, f.T_h, ∅⟩
    (derive p K B).W = (f.W ++ [new]).drop ((f.W ++ [new]).length - K) ∧
      ∃ older, (derive p K B).W = older ++ [new] ∧

  let B := FGBlock.node P s x rs
  let f := finalizeWindow p.E (certificateFolded p K B)

  have hw : (derive p K B).W = (f.W ++ [new]).drop ((f.W ++ [new]).length - K) := by
    change (process_height_events p.E p.cfg K (certificateFolded p K B)).W = _
    rw [process_height_events_def, ite_eq_left ht]
    rfl
  refine ⟨hw, f.W.drop ((f.W ++ [new]).length - K), ?_⟩

    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]

  have happ : (derive p K B).W = f.W.drop ((f.W ++ [new]).length - K) ++ [new] := by

    exact fun d hd => (ord.2.2 d hd new (by simp)).1

theorem actView_admitBlock_movedF (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st) (s : Slot)

    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n))

    (hF : (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg.F ≠ st.fg.F) :
    let A := GridCO.admitProposal p.toParams.engine (actView st) (baseProposal s b raw support) b
      (raw.map baseHead)
    let st' := admitBlock p st s b raw support rows
    let ok := fun c => Block.compatible c (eraseFG st'.fg.F)
    actView st' = { A with
      blocks := A.blocks.filter ok

private theorem admission_r6wW (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st)
    (valid : ∀ P s x rs, FGBlock.node P s x rs ∈ st.fg.TF →
      ∀ a ∈ rs, Window.r6w (Window.derive p p.K_W P) a = true)
    (s : Slot) (b : Block) (raw sup : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n)) :
    ∀ P t x rs, FGBlock.node P t x rs ∈ (admitBlock p st s b raw sup rows).fg.TF →
      ∀ a ∈ rs, Window.r6w (Window.derive p p.K_W P) a = true := by
  cases hP : parentFG st b with
  | none =>
      rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw sup rows (Or.inl hP)]
      exact valid
  | some P =>
      cases accepted : blockAccepted p st s b P rows with
      | false =>
          rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw sup rows (Or.inr ⟨P, hP, accepted⟩)]
          exact valid
      | true =>
          obtain ⟨pool, eq, _⟩ := admitBlock_accepted_eq p st s b raw sup P rows hP accepted
          intro Q t x rs stored a ha
          rw [eq] at stored
          dsimp only at stored
          rw [(accepted_st2 p st h s b raw sup P rows hP accepted).2.1,
            Finset.mem_insert] at stored
          rcases stored with new | old
          · change FGBlock.node Q t x rs = .node P b.slot (packInner (appOf b.body) rows)
              (rows.filterMap RowWire.toRow?) at new
            cases new
            obtain ⟨wire, hw, hd⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp ha
            have hv := (rowsValidForParent_iff p P b.slot rows).mp
              (blockAccepted_rowsValid accepted) wire hw
            rw [Window.rowValidW_def, hd] at hv
            exact hv
          · exact valid Q t x rs old a ha

theorem admitBlock_reconcile_harmless (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st)
    (s : Slot) (b : Block) (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)) (hP : parentFG st b = some P)
    (hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true)
    (hL : ∀ row ∈ st.base.obligations,
      Block.Compatible row.1 (eraseFG (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg.F))
    (hG : ∀ r C, (r, some C) ∈ st.base.genuine →
      Block.Compatible C (eraseFG (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg.F))
    (hS : Block.Compatible st.base.stableRecord
      (eraseFG (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg.F)) :
    (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).base.obligations = st.base.obligations ∧
    (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).base.genuine = st.base.genuine ∧
    (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fastWrite = st.fastWrite ∧
    Block.Preceq st.base.stableRecord (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).base.stableRecord := by
  obtain ⟨pool, heq, -⟩ := admitBlock_accepted_eq p st s b raw support P rows hP hacc
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hob, hgen, hstab, -, -, hmono⟩ :=
    cstoreInv_accepted_pre p st h s b raw support P rows hP hacc
  rw [heq] at hL hG hS ⊢
  dsimp only at hL hG hS hob hgen hstab hmono ⊢
  by_cases hc : (Window.on_block p p.K_W st.fg (fgBlock P b rows)).F = st.fg.F
  · rw [ite_eq_left hc]
    exact ⟨hob, hgen, rfl, by rw [hstab]; exact block_preceq_refl _⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right hc] at hL hG hS ⊢
    rw [reconcile_fg] at hL hG hS
    obtain ⟨he, hpre⟩ := reconcile_harmless_origin
      { st with
        base := GridCO.admitProposal p.toParams.engine st.base (baseProposal s b raw support) b
          (raw.map baseHead)
        fg := Window.on_block p p.K_W st.fg (fgBlock P b rows)
        proposals := st.proposals ++ [⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩] }
      (eraseFG st.fg.F)
      (fastOrigin_congr (st := st) _ rfl hgen h.fastOrigin) (eraseFG_preceq hmono)
      (by rw [hob]; exact hL) (by rw [hgen]; exact hG) (by rw [hstab]; exact hS)
    refine ⟨by rw [he]; exact hob, by rw [he]; exact hgen, by rw [he], ?_⟩
    rw [← hstab]
    exact hpre

theorem admitBlock_sufficient (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st) (s : Slot)
    (b : Block) (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (hwf : wellFormed p ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩ = true)
    (hpar : b.parent ∈ st.base.blocks) (hslot : b.slot ≤ st.slot p)
    (hfresh : ∀ c ∈ st.base.blocks, c.root ≠ b.root)
    (hF : Block.Preceq (eraseFG st.fg.F) b)
    (hvalid : ∀ P, parentFG st b = some P → rowsValidForParent p P b.slot rows = true) :
    b ∈ (process p st ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩).base.blocks ∧
      ∃ P, parentFG st b = some P ∧
        fgBlock P b rows ∈ (process p st ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩).fg.TF := by
  have h0 : Inv0 p st := h.toInv0
  have hg : b ≠ .genesis := by
    intro hb
    simp [wellFormed, Wire.decode, hb] at hwf
  obtain ⟨P, hPT, hPe⟩ := (h.baseTree _).1 hpar
  have hP : parentFG st b = some P := (parentFG_spec st h.rootInj b P).2 ⟨hPT, hPe⟩
  have hfr : ¬ ∃ Y ∈ st.fg.TF, Y.root = b.root := by
    rintro ⟨Y, hY, hr⟩
    exact hfresh _ ((h.baseTree _).2 ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩) (by rw [eraseFG_root, hr])
                           
  have hFm : eraseFG st.fg.F ∈ st.base.blocks := (h.baseTree _).2 ⟨_, h.fg.Fmem, rfl⟩
  have hFne : eraseFG st.fg.F ≠ b := by
    intro he
    exact hfresh _ hFm (by rw [he])
  have hFpar : Block.Preceq (eraseFG st.fg.F) (eraseFG P) := by
    rw [hPe]
    cases b with
    | genesis => exact absurd rfl hg
    | node q sl r =>
        simp only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hF
        rcases hF with hF | hF
        · exact absurd hF hFne
        · exact hF
  have hcl := h.fg.closed
  have hinj := viewRootInj_of_rootInj hcl h.rootInj
  have hFP : FGBlock.Preceq st.fg.F P :=
    preceq_of_eraseFG_preceq hinj ⟨_, h.fg.Fmem, KitFG.preceq_refl _⟩
      ⟨_, hPT, KitFG.preceq_refl _⟩ hFpar
  have hFB : FGBlock.Preceq st.fg.F (fgBlock P b rows) :=
    KitFG.preceq_node_of_preceq _ _ _ hFP
  have hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true := by
    rw [blockAccepted_of_wellFormed p st s b raw support rows P hwf]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hslot, hfr⟩, hFB⟩, hvalid P hP⟩
  obtain ⟨pool, heq, -⟩ := admitBlock_accepted_eq p st s b raw support P rows hP hacc
  have hproc : process p st ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩ =
      admitBlock p st s b raw support rows := rfl
  obtain ⟨hbl, -⟩ := base_admitProposal_accepts p st h0 s b raw support P rows hP hacc
  refine ⟨?_, P, hP, ?_⟩ <;> rw [hproc, heq] <;> dsimp only <;> split
  · rw [hbl]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self b)
  · rw [(reconcile_frame _).2.2.2.1, hbl]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self b)
  · rw [fg_on_block_accepts p st s b P rows hP hacc, Window.window_update_finality_TF]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  · rw [reconcile_fg, fg_on_block_accepts p st s b P rows hP hacc, Window.window_update_finality_TF]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _

theorem admitProposal_base_view (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : Inv0 p st) (s : Slot)
    (b : Block) (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n))
    (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (hP : parentFG st b = some P) (hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true) :
    let W := (raw.map baseHead).foldl
      (fun acc row => GridCO.admitVote p.toParams.engine acc (GridCO.fromHead row))
      { st.base with
        blocks := st.base.blocks ++ [b]
        blockStamp := st.base.blockStamp ++ [(b, st.base.now)]
        proposals := st.base.proposals ++ [baseProposal s b raw support] }
    GridCO.admitProposal p.toParams.engine st.base (baseProposal s b raw support) b
        (raw.map baseHead) = W ∧
      GridCO.admitProposal p.toParams.engine (actView st) (baseProposal s b raw support) b
        (raw.map baseHead) = { W with blocks := (actView st).blocks ++ [b] } ∧
      W.blocks = st.base.blocks ++ [b] := by
  intro W
  obtain ⟨-, hsl, -, -, hps, hs⟩ := blockAccepted_facts hacc
  obtain ⟨-, -, hpar, hb⟩ := accepted_base_facts p st h hP hacc
  obtain ⟨-, hFp, hFb⟩ := accepted_F_facts p st h hP hacc
  refine ⟨admitProposal_of_accept p.toParams.engine st.base s _ b (raw.map baseHead) hsl hpar hb
    hps hs, ?_, (foldVotes_fields _ _ _).1⟩
  have hparv : b.parent ∈ (actView st).blocks := by
    rw [actView_blocks, Block.Compatible, block_compatible_comm]
    exact ⟨hpar, block_compatible_of_preceq hFp⟩
  have hbv : b ∉ (actView st).blocks := fun hv => hb ((actView_blocks st b).1 hv).1
  have e := foldVotes_withBlocks p.toParams.engine (raw.map baseHead)
    { st.base with
      blocks := st.base.blocks ++ [b]
      blockStamp := st.base.blockStamp ++ [(b, st.base.now)]
      proposals := st.base.proposals ++ [baseProposal s b raw support] }
    ((actView st).blocks ++ [b])
  exact (admitProposal_of_accept p.toParams.engine (actView st) s _ b (raw.map baseHead) hsl hparv
    hbv hps hs).trans e

theorem baseBlocks_rootInj (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st) :
    ∀ A ∈ st.base.blocks, ∀ B ∈ st.base.blocks, A.root = B.root → A = B := by
  intro a ha b hb he
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := (h.baseTree a).mp ha
  obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := (h.baseTree b).mp hb
  have hr : A.root = B.root := by simpa only [eraseFG_root] using he
  exact congrArg eraseFG (h.rootInj A hA B hB hr)

theorem base_admitProposal_accepts (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : Inv0 p st) (s : Slot)
    (b : Block) (raw support : List (HeadWire p.n)) (P : FGBlock (Fin p.n))
    (rows : List (RowWire p.n))
    (hP : parentFG st b = some P) (hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true) :
    let base' := GridCO.admitProposal p.toParams.engine st.base (baseProposal s b raw support) b
      (raw.map baseHead)

theorem blockAccepted_slot_pos {p : Params} {st : State p.n} {s : Slot} {b : Block}
    {P : FGBlock (Fin p.n)} {rows : List (RowWire p.n)}
    (hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows = true) :
    0 < b.slot ∧ 4 * p.Δ ≤ st.base.now := by
  obtain ⟨-, hslot, -, -, hparent, -⟩ := blockAccepted_facts hacc
  have hpos : 0 < b.slot := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hparent
  change b.slot ≤ (st.base.now / (4 * p.Δ)).toNat at hslot
  have hn : 0 ≤ st.base.now / (4 * p.Δ) := by
    by_contra hneg
    have hz := Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hneg))
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hslot.trans_eq hz)) hpos
  have hdiv := (Int.le_toNat hn).mp hslot
  have htime := (Int.le_ediv_iff_mul_le (by linarith [p.deltaPos])).mp hdiv
  constructor
  · exact hpos
  · have hb : (1 : Int) ≤ b.slot := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have hd : 0 ≤ 4 * p.Δ := le_of_lt (by linarith [p.deltaPos])
    exact le_trans (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hd) htime

theorem block_preceq_antisymm {A B : Block} (h₁ : Block.Preceq A B) (h₂ : Block.Preceq B A) :
    A = B := by
  have hle : ∀ {X Y : Block}, Block.Preceq X Y → X.depth ≤ Y.depth := by
    intro X Y h
    induction Y with
    | genesis =>
        simp only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        subst h
        exact Nat.le_refl _
    | node p s r ih =>
        simp only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · subst h
          exact Nat.le_refl _
        · have := ih h
          simp only [Block.depth]
          omega
  have heq : ∀ {X Y : Block}, Block.Preceq X Y → Y.depth ≤ X.depth → X = Y := by
    intro X Y h hd
    induction Y with
    | genesis =>
        simp only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        exact h
    | node p s r _ =>
        simp only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have h1 := hle h
          simp only [Block.depth] at hd
          omega
  exact heq h₁ (hle h₂)

      proposals := st.proposals ++ [⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩] }

      (∀ X ∈ st1.fg.TF, ∀ Y ∈ st1.fg.TF, X.root = Y.root → X = Y) ∧

        simpa [eraseFG, Block.Preceq, Block.preceq] using h

      · have he : A = .node p s r x rs := eraseFG_injective h

        exact KitFG.preceq_refl _
      · exact KitFG.preceq_node_of_preceq s r x rs (ih h)

theorem fgsa_confirmationFrom_covers_majority (p : Params) (v : GridCO.State p.n)
    (a B : Block) (s : Slot) (hc : Block.Compatible a B)
    (ha : GridCO.voterCount (GridCO.lateVotes p.toParams.engine v s) <
      2 * SA.prefixSupport p.toParams v s a)
    (hb : GridCO.voterCount (GridCO.lateVotes p.toParams.engine v s) <
      2 * SA.prefixSupport p.toParams v s B)
    (hm : ∀ X, Block.Preceq a X → Block.Preceq X B → X ≠ a → X ∈ v.blocks) :
    ∃ C, SA.confirmationFrom p.toParams a v s = some C ∧ Block.Preceq B C := by
  let score := SA.prefixSupport p.toParams v s
  let elig := fun X => decide
    (GridCO.voterCount (GridCO.lateVotes p.toParams.engine v s) < 2 * score X)
  have hd : DominatedSuffix a B v.blocks score elig := by
    rw [DominatedSuffix_def]
    intro X hax hxb

theorem metaInv_process (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (h : CStoreInv p st) (m : MetaInv p st)
    (o : Wire p.n) : MetaInv p (process p st o) := by
  unfold process
  split
  · rename_i s i b _
    have hv := admitVote_stamps p.toParams.engine st.base ⟨.seat s i, .head b⟩
    refine ⟨m.wireTree, m.treeWire, m.proposalsNodup, ?_, ?_, m.poolDecodes, m.poolNodup,
      m.noGenesisWire⟩
    · change (GridCO.admitVote _ _ _).blockStamp.map Prod.fst = (GridCO.admitVote _ _ _).blocks
      rw [hv.1, hv.2.1]; exact m.stampKeys
    · change (GridCO.admitVote _ _ _).blocks.Nodup
      rw [hv.1]; exact m.blocksNodup
  · exact metaInv_admitRow p st m _
  · rename_i s b raw support rows _
    cases hP : parentFG st b with
    | none =>
        rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inl hP)]
        exact m
    | some P =>
        cases hacc : blockAccepted p st s b P rows with
        | false =>
            rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inr ⟨P, hP, hacc⟩)]
            exact m
        | true =>
            have h0 : Inv0 p st := h.toInv0
            obtain ⟨hg, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := blockAccepted_facts hacc
            obtain ⟨-, hPe, -, hb⟩ := accepted_base_facts p st h0 hP hacc
            have key := accepted_st2 p st h s b raw support P rows hP hacc
            dsimp only at key
            obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4, -, k6⟩ := key
            unfold admitBlock
            rw [hP]
            simp only [hacc, ite_true]
            exact metaInv_foldl_admitRow p rows _
              (metaInv_accepted p st h m s b raw support P rows _ k1 k2 k3 k4 k6 hg hPe hb
                (accepted_rows_decode hacc) (blockAccepted_rowsOk hacc))
  · exact m

theorem preceq_of_eraseFG_preceq {Vw : View V} (hinj : ViewRootInj Vw) {A B : FGBlock V}
    (hA : ∃ W ∈ Vw, FGBlock.Preceq A W) (hB : ∃ W ∈ Vw, FGBlock.Preceq B W)
    (h : Block.Preceq (eraseFG A) (eraseFG B)) : FGBlock.Preceq A B := by
  induction B with
  | genesis =>
      have hg : eraseFG A = .genesis := by
        simpa [eraseFG, Block.Preceq, Block.preceq] using h
      rw [eraseFG_eq_genesis.mp hg]
      exact KitFG.preceq_refl _
  | node p s r rs ih =>
      change Block.preceq (eraseFG A) (Block.node (eraseFG p) s (encFGBody r rs)) = true at h
      simp only [Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · have hAB : A = .node p s r rs := eraseFG_injOn hinj hA hB h
        subst hAB
        exact KitFG.preceq_refl _
      · obtain ⟨W, hW, hBW⟩ := hB
        have hpB : FGBlock.Preceq p (.node p s r rs) := by
          simp only [FGBlock.Preceq, FGBlock.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
          exact Or.inr (KitFG.preceq_refl p)
        exact KitFG.preceq_trans (ih ⟨W, hW, KitFG.preceq_trans hpB hBW⟩ h) hpB

theorem process_cumulative (p : Params) (st : State p.n) (o : Wire p.n) :
    st.fg.TF ⊆ (process p st o).fg.TF ∧
    st.base.blocks <+: (process p st o).base.blocks ∧
    st.base.blockStamp <+: (process p st o).base.blockStamp ∧
    st.base.voteStamp <+: (process p st o).base.voteStamp ∧
    st.proposals <+: (process p st o).proposals ∧
    st.rowPool <+: (process p st o).rowPool := by
  have refl6 : st.fg.TF ⊆ st.fg.TF ∧ st.base.blocks <+: st.base.blocks ∧
      st.base.blockStamp <+: st.base.blockStamp ∧ st.base.voteStamp <+: st.base.voteStamp ∧
      st.proposals <+: st.proposals ∧ st.rowPool <+: st.rowPool :=
    ⟨subset_rfl, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _,
      List.prefix_refl _⟩
  unfold process
  split
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := admitVote_stamps p.toParams.engine st.base
      ⟨.seat _ _, .head _⟩
    refine ⟨subset_rfl, ?_, ?_, h3, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _⟩
    · change st.base.blocks <+: (GridCO.admitVote _ _ _).blocks
      rw [h1]
    · change st.base.blockStamp <+: (GridCO.admitVote _ _ _).blockStamp
      rw [h2]
  · rcases admitRow_eq p st ⟨o.auth, _⟩ with he | he <;> rw [he]
    · exact refl6
    · exact ⟨subset_rfl, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_refl _,
        List.prefix_refl _, List.prefix_append _ _⟩
  · rename_i s b raw support rows _
    cases hP : parentFG st b with
    | none =>
        rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inl hP)]
        exact refl6

        | false =>
            rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inr ⟨P, hP, hacc⟩)]
            exact refl6

theorem rowsValidStored_admitBlock (p : Params) (st : State p.n)

  cases hP : parentFG st b with
  | none =>
      rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inl hP)]
      exact hv
  | some P =>
      cases ha : blockAccepted p st s b P rows with
      | false =>
          rw [admitBlock_refused p st s b raw support rows (Or.inr ⟨P, hP, ha⟩)]
          exact hv

          have hsub : st.fg.TF ⊆ (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).fg.TF :=
            (process_cumulative p st ⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩).1
          have hprops : (admitBlock p st s b raw support rows).proposals =
              st.proposals ++ [⟨.proposer s, .proposal b raw support rows⟩] := by
            obtain ⟨pool, heq, _⟩ := admitBlock_accepted_eq p st s b raw support P rows hP ha
            rw [heq]
            exact (accepted_st2 p st h s b raw support P rows hP ha).1
          intro o ho t c raw' support' rows' hd
          rw [hprops, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at ho

theorem stored_fg_eq_of_erase_eq (p : Params) (st st' : State p.n)
    (h : CStoreInv p st) (h' : CStoreInv p st') (m : MetaInv p st) (m' : MetaInv p st')
    {X Y : FGBlock (Fin p.n)} (hX : X ∈ st.fg.TF) (hY : Y ∈ st'.fg.TF)
    (he : eraseFG X = eraseFG Y) : X = Y := by
  induction X generalizing Y with
  | genesis => exact (eraseFG_eq_genesis.1 he.symm).symm
  | node P s r rows ih =>
      cases Y with
      | genesis => exact absurd (eraseFG_eq_genesis.1 he) (by simp)
      | node P' s' r' rows' =>
          have he' := he
          simp only [eraseFG, Block.node.injEq] at he'
          obtain ⟨hP, rfl, hx⟩ := he'
          obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := encFGBody_inj hx
          have hPP : P = P' := ih (h.fg.closed _ hX) (h'.fg.closed _ hY) hP
          subst hPP
          obtain ⟨sx, raw, sup, rw, ho, hXr⟩ :=
            stored_wire_of_block p st h m hX (by simp)
          obtain ⟨sy, raw', sup', rw', ho', hYr⟩ :=
            stored_wire_of_block p st' h' m' hY (by simp)
          obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := contentAgree p m m' _ _ _ _ _ ho _ _ _ _ _ ho' (by rw [he])
          change rows = _ at hXr
          change rows' = _ at hYr
          rw [hXr, hYr]

def wellFormed (p : Params) (o : Wire p.n) : Bool :=
  match o.decode with
  | some (.vote _ _ _) => true
  | some (.row _ body) => body.valid
  | some (.block s b raw support rows) =>
      b != .genesis && s == b.slot && decide (b.parent.slot < b.slot) &&
        raw.all (fun v => match v.decode? with
          | some (r, _, _) => r + 1 == b.slot
          | none => false) &&
        support.all (fun v => decide (v ∈ raw)) &&
        rows.all RowWire.valid &&
        rowsOk b rows
  | none => false

end AvailableChain.FGSA
end

theorem block_preceq_trans (A B C : Block) :
    Block.Preceq A B → Block.Preceq B C → Block.Preceq A C := by
  intro hAB hBC
  induction C with
  | genesis =>
      have hB : B = .genesis := by simpa [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq] using hBC
      subst hB; exact hAB
  | node p s x ih =>
      unfold Block.Preceq Block.preceq at hBC
      rcases Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp hBC with h | h
      · have : B = .node p s x := of_decide_eq_true h
        subst this; exact hAB
      · have := ih h
        unfold Block.Preceq Block.preceq
        exact Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mpr (Or.inr this)

theorem batch_anchored : BatchStatement := by
  rw [BatchStatement_def]
  intro n tree D raw support Hon h m anchor X hraw hsupport hcard hclean hbatch
    hother hb hcompatible hpath hanchor
  have bounds := batch_counts tree D raw support Hon h m X
    hraw hsupport hcard hclean hbatch hother hb
  refine ⟨bounds, ?_⟩
  apply walk_covers_of_dominated_suffix_of_anchor_eligible anchor X tree
    (goldfishScore tree raw support)
    (fun B => decide (voterCount D < 2 * goldfishScore tree raw support B))
    hcompatible ?_ (decide_eq_true_eq.mpr hanchor)
  rw [DominatedSuffix_def]
  intro C hAC hCX
  have hscore := (bounds.2.2.1 C hCX).1
  have hpass := anchor_passes h m (voterCount D) (goldfishScore tree raw support C)
    hb bounds.2.1 hscore
  refine ⟨hpath C hAC hCX, hpass.2, ?_⟩
  intro Y _hY hp _hel hne
  have hdepth : C.depth = Y.depth := by
    cases C with
    | genesis =>
        cases Y with
        | genesis => rfl
        | node P s id => change some P = none at hp; contradiction
    | node P s id =>
        cases Y with
        | genesis => change none = some P at hp; contradiction
        | node Q t jd =>
            change some Q = some P at hp
            cases Option.some.inj hp
            rfl
  have hconflict : Block.compatible C Y = false := by
    apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    intro hc
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp hc with hCY | hYC
    · exact hne (prefix_eq_of_depth C Y hCY (le_of_eq hdepth.symm)).symm
    · exact hne (prefix_eq_of_depth Y C hYC (le_of_eq hdepth))
  have hXY : Block.compatible X Y = false := by
    apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    intro hc
    have hCY := block_compatible_of_preceq_compatible hCX hc
    change Block.compatible C Y = true at hCY
    simp only [hconflict, Bool.false_eq_true] at hCY
  have hrest := bounds.2.2.2.1 Y hXY
  have hlt := hb.lt
  omega

end AvailableChain.Gen.AC

theorem block_preceq_antisymm {A B : Block} (h₁ : Block.Preceq A B) (h₂ : Block.Preceq B A) :
    A = B := by
  have hle : ∀ {X Y : Block}, Block.Preceq X Y → X.depth ≤ Y.depth := by
    intro X Y h
    induction Y with
    | genesis =>
        change decide (X = Block.genesis) = true at h
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        subst h
        exact Nat.le_refl _
    | node p s r ih =>
        change (decide (X = Block.node p s r) || Block.preceq X p) = true at h
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · subst h
          exact Nat.le_refl _
        · have := ih h
          change X.depth ≤ p.depth + 1
          omega
  have heq : ∀ {X Y : Block}, Block.Preceq X Y → Y.depth ≤ X.depth → X = Y := by
    intro X Y h hd
    induction Y with
    | genesis =>
        change decide (X = Block.genesis) = true at h
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        exact h
    | node p s r _ =>
        change (decide (X = Block.node p s r) || Block.preceq X p) = true at h
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have h1 := hle h
          change p.depth + 1 ≤ X.depth at hd
          omega
  exact heq h₁ (hle h₂)

      (tree.filter (fun b => b.parent? == some anchor && eligible b)).foldl
        (fun best b => match best with
          | none => some b
          | some old => if score old < score b || (score old == score b && old.root < b.root)
              then some b else best) none := by
  let children := tree.filter (fun b => b.parent? == some anchor && eligible b)
  change (match children.foldl (chooseChild score) none with
    | none => none
    | some b => if children.any (fun c => c != b && score c == score b && c.root == b.root)
        then none else some b) = children.foldl (chooseChild score) none
  cases hb : children.foldl (chooseChild score) none with
  | none => rfl
  | some B =>
      have hB : B ∈ children := (walk_aux_fold_choose_origin score children none B hb).resolve_left
        (by simp)
      have htie : children.any

        apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr

        obtain ⟨C, hC, hc⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, beq_iff_eq] at hc

      change (if children.any (fun c => c != B && score c == score B && c.root == B.root)
        then none else some B) = some B
      rw [htie]

      ∀ B ∈ tree, B.parent? = some anchor → eligible B = false := by

  change children.foldl (chooseChild score) none = none ↔ _
  have hempty : children.foldl (chooseChild score) none = none ↔ children = [] := by

    apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr

    by_cases hp : B.parent? = some anchor

    · simp [hp]

theorem walk_aux_ghostStep_of_unique_best (tree : List Block) (score : Block → Nat)
    (eligible : Block → Bool) (anchor C : Block)
    (hc : C ∈ tree) (hp : C.parent? = some anchor) (he : eligible C = true)
    (hbest : ∀ D ∈ tree, D.parent? = some anchor → eligible D = true →
      score D ≤ score C ∧ (score D = score C → D.root ≤ C.root))
    (hunique : ∀ D ∈ tree, D.parent? = some anchor → eligible D = true →
      score D = score C → D.root = C.root → D = C) :
    ghostStep tree score eligible anchor = some C := by
  let children := tree.filter (fun B => B.parent? == some anchor && eligible B)
  have hC : C ∈ children := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hc, by simp [hp, he]⟩
  have hex : ∃ B, children.foldl (chooseChild score) none = some B := by
    cases hs : children with
    | nil => simp [hs] at hC
    | cons D xs => exact walk_aux_fold_choose_some score xs D
  obtain ⟨B, hf⟩ := hex
  have hB := (walk_aux_fold_choose_origin score children none B hf).resolve_left (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hb, hcond⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hB
  have ⟨hpar, helig⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcond
  have hpar' : B.parent? = some anchor := by simpa using hpar
  have hBC := hbest B hb hpar' helig
  have hCB := (walk_aux_fold_bounds score children none B hf).2 C hC
  have hs : score B = score C := le_antisymm hBC.1 hCB.1
  have hr : B.root = C.root := le_antisymm (hBC.2 hs) (hCB.2 hs.symm)
  have hEq := hunique B hb hpar' helig hs hr
  subst B
  have htie : children.any
      (fun D => D != C && score D == score C && D.root == C.root) = false := by
    apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
    intro ht
    obtain ⟨D, hd, hkey⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp ht
    obtain ⟨hdt, hdcond⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hd
    have ⟨hdp, hde⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hdcond
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, beq_iff_eq] at hkey
    exact hkey.1.1 (hunique D hdt (by simpa using hdp) hde hkey.1.2 hkey.2)
  change (match children.foldl (chooseChild score) none with
    | none => none
    | some B => if children.any (fun D => D != B && score D == score B && D.root == B.root)
        then none else some B) = some C
  rw [hf]
  change (if children.any (fun D => D != C && score D == score C && D.root == C.root)
    then none else some C) = some C
  rw [htie]
  rfl

    (eligible : Block → Bool) (anchor C : Block)

    ∀ D ∈ tree, D.parent? = some anchor → eligible D = true →
      score D = score C → D.root = C.root → D = C := by
  let children := tree.filter (fun B => B.parent? == some anchor && eligible B)

    | none => none

  cases hf : children.foldl (chooseChild score) none with
  | none =>
      rw [hf] at h
      change none = some C at h
      contradiction
  | some B =>
      rw [hf] at h
      change (if children.any (fun D => D != B && score D == score B && D.root == B.root)
        then none else some B) = some C at h
      split at h
      · contradiction
      · rename_i hno
        cases h

          apply List.any_eq_true.mpr
          exact ⟨D, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd, by simp [hp, he]⟩, by simp [hn, hs, hr]⟩

theorem walk_aux_ghostWalk_terminal_of_card (tree : List Block) (score : Block → Nat)
    (eligible : Block → Bool) (fuel : Nat) (anchor : Block)
    (hcard : (tree.toFinset.filter (fun C => Block.Prec anchor C)).card ≤ fuel) :
    ghostStep tree score eligible (ghostWalk tree score eligible fuel anchor) = none := by
  induction fuel generalizing anchor with
  | zero =>
      apply (walk_aux_ghostStep_none_iff_of_rootInjective tree score eligible anchor).mpr
      intro C hC hp
      have hd := walk_aux_child_depth anchor C hp
      have hm : C ∈ tree.toFinset.filter (fun C => Block.Prec anchor C) := by
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hC,
          (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_, walk_aux_parent_prefix _ _ hp⟩⟩
        intro he
        rw [← he] at hd
        omega
      have hh := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨C, hm⟩
      omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
      cases hs : ghostStep tree score eligible anchor with
      | none => rw [walk_aux_walk_none hs]; exact hs
      | some child =>
          rw [walk_aux_walk_some hs]
          apply ih child
          have hc := walk_aux_ghostStep_child tree score eligible anchor child hs
          have hd := walk_aux_child_depth anchor child hc.2.1
          let S := tree.toFinset.filter (fun C => Block.Prec anchor C)
          have hm : child ∈ S := by
            apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            refine ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hc.1,
              (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_, walk_aux_parent_prefix _ _ hc.2.1⟩⟩
            intro he
            rw [← he] at hd
            omega
          have hsub : tree.toFinset.filter (fun C => Block.Prec child C) ⊆ S.erase child := by
            intro C hC
            obtain ⟨ht, hprec⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hC
            obtain ⟨hne, hchild⟩ := (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mp hprec
            apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
            refine ⟨Ne.symm hne, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ht, (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_,
              block_preceq_trans (walk_aux_parent_prefix _ _ hc.2.1) hchild⟩⟩⟩
            intro he
            have hh := prefix_depth child C hchild
            rw [← he] at hh
            omega
          have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          have hdrop := Finset.card_erase_add_one hm
          change S.card ≤ fuel + 1 at hcard
          omega

  obtain ⟨hne, hAC'⟩ := (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mp hAC

  | genesis => exact (hne (of_decide_eq_true hAC')).elim
  | node X s id =>

        change (decide (anchor = Block.node X s id) || Block.preceq anchor X) = true at hAC'
        exact (Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp hAC').resolve_left (by simpa using hne)

      have he := walk_aux_same_child_of_common D (.node X s id) target hd.2.1 hDT hCT
      subst D
      exact ⟨X, rfl, hAX, hXT,
        (walk_aux_ghostStep_eraseDups tree score eligible X).symm.trans hs⟩

theorem walk_reanchor_of_best_ancestry (anchor target : Block) (tree : List Block)

      ∃ C, C.parent? = some X ∧ Block.Preceq C target ∧ C ∈ tree ∧
        eligible C = true ∧ ∀ D ∈ tree, D.parent? = some X → eligible D = true →
          score D ≤ score C ∧ (score D = score C → D.root ≤ C.root)) :
    ghost anchor tree score eligible = ghost target tree score eligible := by
  have hpath : ∀ C, Block.Prec anchor C → Block.Preceq C target → C ∈ tree := by
    intro C hAC hCT
    obtain ⟨hne, hAC'⟩ := (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mp hAC
    cases C with
    | genesis => exact (hne (of_decide_eq_true hAC')).elim
    | node X s id =>
        have hAX : Block.Preceq anchor X := by
          change (decide (anchor = Block.node X s id) || Block.preceq anchor X) = true at hAC'
          exact (Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp hAC').resolve_left (by simpa using hne)
        have hXT : Block.Prec X target := by
          apply (walk_aux_prec_iff _ _).mpr
          refine ⟨?_, block_preceq_trans (walk_aux_parent_prefix X (.node X s id) rfl) hCT⟩
          intro he
          have hd := prefix_depth (.node X s id) target hCT
          rw [← he] at hd
          change X.depth + 1 ≤ X.depth at hd
          omega
        obtain ⟨D, hp, hDT, hm, _, _⟩ := hancestry X hAX hXT
        exact walk_aux_same_child_of_common D (.node X s id) target hp hDT hCT ▸ hm
  have hc : Block.Preceq target (ghost anchor tree score eligible) := by
    apply walk_aux_walk_covers_steps tree.eraseDups score eligible anchor target ?_
      tree.eraseDups.length anchor (block_preceq_refl _) ha
      (walk_aux_suffix_depth_le_fuel anchor target tree ha hpath)
    intro X hAX hXT
    obtain ⟨C, hp, hCT, hm, hel, hbest⟩ := hancestry X hAX hXT
    refine ⟨C, ?_, hCT⟩
    rw [walk_aux_ghostStep_eraseDups]
    exact walk_aux_ghostStep_of_best tree score eligible X C hm hp hel hbest
  exact walk_aux_ghostWalk_reanchor_terminal tree.eraseDups score eligible tree.eraseDups.length
    tree.eraseDups.length anchor target ha hc
    (walk_aux_ghost_terminal anchor tree score eligible)
    (walk_aux_ghost_terminal target tree score eligible)

theorem admitProposal_blocks_ordered (p : Params) {n : Nat} (st : State n)
    (o : Wire n) (target : Block) (raw : List (HeadWire n))
    (h : ∀ b ∈ st.blocks, SlotOrdered b) :
    ∀ b ∈ (admitProposal p st o target raw).blocks, SlotOrdered b := by
  unfold admitProposal
  dsimp only
  split <;> split
  all_goals first
    | exact h
    | rename_i hgood
      rw [fold_votes_blocks]
      intro b hb
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hb with hold | hnew
      · exact h b hold
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hnew
        subst b
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_true_eq,
          not_or, Bool.not_eq_false, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hgood
        have hparent : blockKnown st target.parent = true := by tauto
        have hslot : target.parent.slot < target.slot := by tauto
        have ho := h _ (of_decide_eq_true hparent)
        cases target with
        | genesis => exact True.intro
        | node parent s root => exact ⟨hslot, ho⟩

theorem admitProposal_stored_prefix_closed (p : Params) {n : Nat}
    (st : State n) (o : Wire n) (b : Block)
    (raw : List (HeadWire n)) (hclosed : StoredPrefixClosed st) :
    StoredPrefixClosed (admitProposal p st o b raw) := by
  by_cases hknown : blockKnown st b.parent = true
  · let bad : Bool :=
      b.slot > (st.now / (4 * p.Δ)).toNat || !blockKnown st b.parent ||
        b ∈ st.blocks || !(b.parent.slot < b.slot) ||
        !(match o.auth with
          | .proposer s => s == b.slot
          | _ => false)
    let st' : State n := { st with
      blocks := st.blocks ++ [b]
      blockStamp := st.blockStamp ++ [(b, st.now)]
      proposals := st.proposals ++ [o] }
    change StoredPrefixClosed
      (if bad then st else raw.foldl (fun acc row => admitVote p acc (fromHead row)) st')
    by_cases hbad : bad = true
    · simpa [hbad] using hclosed
    · have hfalse : bad = false := by cases h : bad <;> simp_all
      have hfold : StoredPrefixClosed
          (raw.foldl (fun acc row => admitVote p acc (fromHead row)) st') := by
        apply stored_prefix_closed_of_same_blocks st'
        · exact fold_admitVote_blocks p raw st'
        · intro K hK B hB hBK
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hK with hold | hnew
          · exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (hclosed K hold B hB hBK))
          · have hKeq : K = b := by simpa using hnew
            subst K
            have hcase : B = b ∨ Block.preceq B b.parent = true := by
              cases b with
              | genesis => exact False.elim (hB (by simpa [Block.preceq] using hBK))
              | node parent slot root =>
                  simpa [Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true] using! hBK
            rcases hcase with heq | hparent
            · exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr (by simp [heq]))
            · have hparentKnown : b.parent ∈ st.blocks := by
                simpa [blockKnown] using hknown
              exact List.mem_append.mpr
                (Or.inl (hclosed b.parent hparentKnown B hB hparent))
      simpa [hfalse] using hfold
  · have hfalse : blockKnown st b.parent = false := by
      cases hbool : blockKnown st b.parent <;> simp_all
    simpa [admitProposal, hfalse] using hclosed

          simpa [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true] using hB

theorem ghostWalk_covers_path (tree : List Block) (score : Block → Nat)
    (eligible : Block → Bool) (B : Block)
    (hpath : ∀ C, C ≠ .genesis → Block.Preceq C B → C ∈ tree)
    (helig : ∀ C, C ≠ .genesis → Block.Preceq C B → eligible C = true)
    (hdom : ∀ C, C ≠ .genesis → Block.Preceq C B → ∀ D ∈ tree,
      D.parent? = C.parent? → eligible D = true → D ≠ C → score D < score C)
    (fuel : Nat) (anchor : Block) (ha : Block.Preceq anchor B)
    (hf : B.depth ≤ anchor.depth + fuel) :
    Block.Preceq B (ghostWalk tree score eligible fuel anchor) := by
  induction fuel generalizing anchor with
  | zero =>
      have := prefix_eq_of_depth anchor B ha (by simpa using hf)
      subst anchor
      exact block_preceq_self _
  | succ fuel ih =>
      by_cases he : anchor = B
      · subst anchor
        exact ghostWalk_extends tree score eligible (fuel + 1) B
      · obtain ⟨C, hpar, hCB⟩ := path_child anchor B ha he
        have hn : C ≠ .genesis := by intro hz; simp [hz, Block.parent?] at hpar
        have hdepth : C.depth = anchor.depth + 1 := by
          cases C with
          | genesis => contradiction
          | node parent s id =>
              have heq : parent = anchor := by simpa [Block.parent?] using hpar
              subst parent; rfl
        have hs := ghostStep_of_strict_dominance tree score eligible anchor C
          (hpath C hn hCB) hpar (helig C hn hCB) (by
            intro D hd hp he hnD
            exact hdom C hn hCB D hd (hp.trans hpar.symm) he hnD)
        rw [ghostWalk, hs]
        exact ih C hCB (by omega)

      (goldfishEligible reader.blocks (voterView p reader s) (voterSupportView p reader s) s)) := by

  let dstScore := goldfishScore reader.blocks (voterView p reader s) (voterSupportView p reader s)
  let srcEligible := goldfishEligible source.blocks (proposerView source s)
    (proposerSupportView source s) s
  let dstEligible := goldfishEligible reader.blocks (voterView p reader s)
    (voterSupportView p reader s) s
  have hroot : RootInjectiveBelow tree := by
    intro A C hA hC he
    obtain ⟨D, hd, hAD⟩ := hA
    obtain ⟨F, hf, hCF⟩ := hC
    exact hreaderRoot A C ⟨D, htree hd, hAD⟩
      ⟨F, htree hf, hCF⟩ he

      dstEligible C = srcEligible C := by
    intro C hc ht
    dsimp [dstEligible, srcEligible, goldfishEligible]

theorem honest_proposal_exists {V : Type} [DecidableEq V]
    {p : Params} {E : Env V} {rho : Run V (gridCO p)}
    (hexec : ExecutionValid (gridCO p) E rho) (hΔ : E.Δ = p.Δ)
    (s : Slot) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hawake : HonestAwakeProposer E rho s)
    (hh : proposalTime p s ≤ rho.horizon) :
    ∃ B, HonestProposalAt E (gridInterface p) rho s B := by
  have hpub : PublicTime E (proposalTime p s) := by
    refine ⟨4 * s, ?_⟩
    simp only [proposalTime, hΔ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  have ht : 0 ≤ proposalTime p s :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt p.deltaPos)) (Int.natCast_nonneg s)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp
    (hexec.tick_total _ hawake.1 _ hpub ht hh)
  let st := clock p (Run.stateBefore (gridCO p) rho i (rho.proposerOf s)) (proposalTime p s)
  let parent := forkChoice st st.blocks (proposerView st s) (proposerSupportView st s) s
  let B := Block.node parent s 0
  let msg := Msg.proposal B ((proposerView st s).filterMap toHead?)
    ((proposerSupportView st s).filterMap toHead?)
  have hp : propose p st s = some msg := by simp [propose, Nat.ne_of_gt hs, msg, B, parent]
  refine ⟨B, hawake.1, msg, rfl, i, hi, ?_⟩
  change _ ∈ Run.emittedAt (gridCO p) E rho i (rho.proposerOf s) (proposalTime p s)
  simp only [Run.emittedAt, show E.awake (rho.proposerOf s) (proposalTime p s) = true from hawake.2,
    ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append]
  apply Or.inl
  apply Or.inr
  apply List.mem_filterMap.mpr
  refine ⟨s, (slotsAt_spec p s _).mpr rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  change (propose p st s).map _ = _
  rw [hp]
  rfl

end AvailableChain.GridCO

theorem honest_proposal_tree_reflects {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V]

    (r : Slot) (hsync : SynchronousLabel p E rho (r + 1))
    (hready : ProposalRelayReady p E rho (r + 1)) (B : Block)
    (hB : HonestProposalAt E (gridInterface p) rho (r + 1) B)
    (reader : V) (hr : reader ∈ rho.honest) :
    ∀ C ∈ voterTree p (nextHeadState p rho r reader) (r + 1),
      C = B ∨ C ∈ (proposalState p rho (r + 1)).blocks := by
  have hs := hsync.1.toScheduleWellFormed
  have hpropTime : proposalTime p (r + 1) ≤ rho.horizon := by
    have hh := hsync.2.2.1
    dsimp [gateTime] at hh
    linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have hf := nextHeadState_frozenAt_of_schedule p E rho hs hΔ r reader hr (by
    apply le_trans _ hpropTime
    dsimp [freezeTime, proposalTime]; nlinarith [p.deltaPos])
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨_, hm⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hC
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, hf] at hm
  rcases Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp hm with hfrozen | hproposal
  · right
    have hm' : C ∈ (Run.stateBeforeTime (gridCO p) rho (freezeTime p r) reader).blocks :=
      (List.mem_filter.mp (of_decide_eq_true hfrozen)).1
    exact frozen_blocks_at_proposer p E rho hsync.1 hΔ r hready hpropTime hB.1 reader hr C hm'
  · obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hproposal
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hp⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hD

theorem liveTarget_preceq_liveRoot {n : Nat} (st : State n)
    (hcomparable : ComparableTargets st)
    (g : Nat) (b : Block) (deadline : Time)
    (hrow : (b, g, deadline) ∈ st.obligations)
    (hlive : st.now < deadline) :
    Block.preceq b (liveRoot st) = true := by
  have hb : b ∈ liveTargets st := by
    apply List.mem_filterMap.mpr
    exact ⟨(b, g, deadline), hrow, by simp [hlive]⟩
  obtain ⟨horigin, hdeep⟩ := liveRoot_is_deepest st
  have hdepth := hdeep b hb
  rcases horigin with hgenesis | hmem
  · rw [hgenesis] at hdepth ⊢
    cases b with
    | genesis => decide
    | node parent slot root => simp [Block.depth] at hdepth
  · obtain ⟨row, hrow', htarget⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hmem
    rcases row with ⟨K', level, expiry⟩
    by_cases htime : st.now < expiry
    · simp [htime] at htarget
      have hKeq : K' = liveRoot st := htarget
      have hcomp := hcomparable b g deadline hrow K' level expiry hrow'
      exact preceq_of_compatible_depth_le b (liveRoot st)
        (hKeq ▸ hcomp) hdepth
    · simp [htime] at htarget

    (v : FGHeightView V) : Prop where

    ∀ B, 1 ≤ (v B).h

  h_mono :
    ∀ {A B}, FGBlock.Preceq A B → (v A).h ≤ (v B).h

  node_cases :
    ∀ (p : FGBlock V) (s : Slot) (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row V)),
      let B := FGBlock.node p s x rs
      ((v B).h = (v p).h ∧ (v B).T_h = (v p).T_h) ∨
      ((v B).h = (v p).h + 1 ∧ (v B).T_h = B)

  entry_preceq :
    ∀ B, FGBlock.Preceq (v B).T_h B

  entry_same_height :
    ∀ B, (v (v B).T_h).h = (v B).h

  entry_idem :
    ∀ B, (v (v B).T_h).T_h = (v B).T_h

  entry_plateau :
    ∀ {A B}, FGBlock.Preceq A B →
      (v A).h = (v B).h → (v A).T_h = (v B).T_h

  justified_preceq_entry :
    ∀ B, FGBlock.Preceq (v B).J (v B).T_h

  justified_below_height :
    ∀ B, (v B).h_j < (v B).h

  target_sub_progress :
    ∀ B, (v B).target_participation ⊆ (v B).progress

  target_origin :
    ∀ B i, i ∈ (v B).target_participation →
      ∃ (W : FGBlock V) (a : Row V),
        FGBlock.Preceq W B ∧ a ∈ W.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
        a.height_pair = .vote (v B).h (v B).T_h.root false

  progress_origin :
    ∀ B i, i ∈ (v B).progress →
      ∃ (W : FGBlock V) (a : Row V),
        FGBlock.Preceq W B ∧ a ∈ W.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
        a.height_pair.matchesEntry (v B).h (v B).T_h.root = true

  height_crossing :
    ∀ (C : FGBlock V) (y : Height),
      1 ≤ y → y < (v C).h →
      ∃ X : FGBlock V,
        FGBlock.Preceq X C ∧ (v X).h = y ∧
        ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧
          ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ (W : FGBlock V) (a : Row V),
            FGBlock.Preceq W C ∧ a ∈ W.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
            a.height_pair.matchesEntry y X.root = true

  justification_certificate :
    ∀ D, (v D).h_j ≠ 0 →
      ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧
        ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ (W : FGBlock V) (a : Row V),
          FGBlock.Preceq W D ∧ a ∈ W.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
          a.height_pair = .vote (v D).h_j (v D).J.root false

theorem F_eq_J_of_heights (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (D : FGBlock V)
    (h : (derive E cfg D).h_F = (derive E cfg D).h_j) :
    (derive E cfg D).F = (derive E cfg D).J := by
  induction D with
  | genesis => rfl
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, hJ, hhj, hF, hhF⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
      have hord := chainOrder_afterFin E (chainOrder_foldRows (.node p s x rs) rs
        (chainOrder_derive E cfg p) (by rw [derive_L]; exact preceq_parent_node p s x rs))
      rw [derive_node E cfg p s x rs] at h ⊢
      set σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs with hσ
      have key : (afterFin E σ).h_F = (afterFin E σ).h_j →
          (afterFin E σ).F = (afterFin E σ).J := by
        intro hx
        unfold afterFin at hx ⊢
        split_ifs at hx ⊢
        · rfl
        · rw [hF, hJ]
          exact ih (hhF.symm.trans (hx.trans hhj))
      rw [process_height_events_eq] at h ⊢
      split_ifs at h ⊢
      · exact absurd h (Nat.ne_of_lt hord.finalized_below_height)
      · exact key h
      · exact key h

theorem bit_from_row : BitFromRowStatement := by
  intro V _ _ _ E cfg kind parent W slot body rows a ha hCW hm hs
  have hk : bitHeight kind (derive E cfg parent) = bitHeight kind (derive E cfg W) := by
    cases kind <;> exact hs.1
  have hlow := bit_height_mono E cfg kind (preceq_parent_node parent slot body rows)
  have hhigh := bit_height_mono E cfg kind hCW
  have hpc : bitHeight kind (derive E cfg parent) =
      bitHeight kind (derive E cfg (.node parent slot body rows)) := by
        simp only [Height] at *
        omega
  apply bits_persist_height E cfg kind hCW (hpc.symm.trans hk)
  rw [node_bits_eq_fold E cfg kind parent slot body rows hpc]
  have hm' : rowMatchesBit kind
      { derive E cfg parent with s := (FGBlock.node parent slot body rows).slot } a := by
    cases kind <;> exact hm
  have hc := bit_fold_covered kind rows
    { derive E cfg parent with s := (FGBlock.node parent slot body rows).slot } a.signer
    (Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl, hm'⟩)
  cases kind <;> exact hc
