theorem cross_cases_of_laws
    {E : Electorate V} {v : FGHeightView V}
    (laws : FGHeightLaws E v) (jlaws : FGJustificationLaws v)
    {U W : FGBlock V} {y : Height}
    (hU : (v U).h = y ∧ (v U).T_h = U)
    (hUW : FGBlock.Preceq U W.parent)
    (hP : (v W.parent).h = y) (hW : (v W).h = y + 1) :
    ((v W.parent).h = y ∧ (v W).h = y + 1 ∧ (v W).J = U ∧ (v W).h_j = y) ∨
    ((v W.parent).h = y ∧ (v W).h = y + 1 ∧ (v W).h_j < y) := by
  have hj := laws.justified_below_height W
  rw [hW] at hj
  by_cases heq : (v W).h_j = y
  · left
    have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
      have := laws.one_le_h U
      rw [hU.1] at this
      simp only [Height] at *
      omega
    have hJh := jlaws.J_height W (heq ▸ hy)
    rw [heq] at hJh
    have hJW := preceq_trans (laws.justified_preceq_entry W) (laws.entry_preceq W)
    have hPW : FGBlock.Preceq W.parent W := by
      cases W with
      | genesis => exact preceq_refl _
      | node P s x rs => exact preceq_parent_node P s x rs
    have hUW' := preceq_trans hUW hPW
    have hJ : (v W).J = U := by
      rcases preceq_total_of_common hJW hUW' with hJU | hUJ
      · have ht := laws.entry_plateau hJU (hJh.trans hU.1.symm)
        rw [jlaws.J_entry W, hU.2] at ht
        exact ht
      · have ht := laws.entry_plateau hUJ (hU.1.trans hJh.symm)
        rw [hU.2, jlaws.J_entry W] at ht
        exact ht.symm
    exact ⟨hP, hW, hJ, heq⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨hP, hW, by simp only [Height] at *; omega⟩

end AvailableChain.KitFG
end

    (x : Nat) (rs : List (Row V))
    (hup : (derive E cfg p).h < (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h) :
    (∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧ ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ a ∈ chainRows (.node p s x rs), a.signer = i ∧
        a.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg p).h (derive E cfg p).T_h.root false) ∨
      (derive E cfg p).T_h.slot + cfg.timeoutDelay ≤ s := by
  set σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs with hσ
  obtain ⟨-, hh, hT, -⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
  have hs : σ.s = s := foldRows_s (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
  have hw := folded_witnesses E cfg p s x rs
  have htarget : E.IsQuorum (afterFin E σ).target_participation →
      ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧ ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ a ∈ chainRows (.node p s x rs),
        a.signer = i ∧
        a.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg p).h (derive E cfg p).T_h.root false := by
    intro hq
    rw [afterFin_target_participation] at hq
    refine ⟨_, hq, fun i hi => ?_⟩

    rw [hh, hT] at hap
    exact ⟨a, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hc ha, hai, hap⟩
  rw [derive_node, process_height_events_eq] at hup
  split_ifs at hup with h1 h2
  · exact Or.inl (htarget (isQuorum_of_targetQuorum E h1))
  · rcases quorum_of_progReady E cfg h2 with hq | ⟨hm, -⟩
    · exact Or.inl (htarget hq)
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rwa [afterFin_T_h, afterFin_s, hT, hs] at hm

  | node p s x rs =>
      exact transition_finality_of_cover E cfg (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs)
        rs S hlt hquorum hcover

theorem e1Weight_of_finalityQC_not_preceq (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (B W : FGBlock V)
    (hJ : (derive E cfg B).h_j ≠ 0)
    (hW : (derive E cfg B).h_j < (derive E cfg W).h)
    (hnot : ¬ FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg B).J W)
    (A : Finset (Row V)) (Q : Finset V) (hQ : E.IsQuorum Q)
    (hfin : ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ a ∈ A, a.signer = i ∧
      a.finality_pair = some ⟨(derive E cfg B).h_j, (derive E cfg B).J.root⟩) :
    HasE1WeightBetween E A (chainRows W) := by
  obtain ⟨X, hne, Qc, hQc, hwc⟩ := exists_crossing_quorum_ne_justified E cfg B W hJ hW hnot
  refine ⟨Q ∩ Qc, quorum_intersection E hQ hQc, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hf, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
  obtain ⟨f, hfA, hfi, hfp⟩ := hfin i hf
  obtain ⟨b, hbW, hbi, hm⟩ := hwc i hc
  exact ⟨f, hfA, b, hbW, hfi, hbi,
    e1Slashable_of_matchesEntry f b _ X.root _ (hfi.trans hbi.symm) hfp hm hne⟩

theorem e1Weight_of_finalityQC_not_preceq (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (B W : FGBlock V)
  (hroot : RootInjectiveOn B W)
    (hJ : (derive E cfg B).h_j ≠ 0)
    (hW : (derive E cfg B).h_j < (derive E cfg W).h)
    (hnot : ¬ FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg B).J W)
    (A : Finset (Row V)) (Q : Finset V) (hQ : E.IsQuorum Q)
    (hfin : ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ a ∈ A, a.signer = i ∧
      a.finality_pair = some ⟨(derive E cfg B).h_j, (derive E cfg B).J.root⟩) :
    HasE1WeightBetween E A (chainRows W) := by
  obtain ⟨X, hne, Qc, hQc, hwc⟩ := exists_crossing_quorum_ne_justified E cfg B W hroot hJ hW hnot
  refine ⟨Q ∩ Qc, quorum_intersection E hQ hQc, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hf, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
  obtain ⟨f, hfA, hfi, hfp⟩ := hfin i hf
  obtain ⟨b, hbW, hbi, hm⟩ := hwc i hc
  exact ⟨f, hfA, b, hbW, hfi, hbi,
    e1Slashable_of_matchesEntry f b _ X.root _ (hfi.trans hbi.symm) hfp hm hne⟩

theorem e1Weight_or_finalized_compatible_of_le (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    (B₁ B₂ : FGBlock V)
    (hle : (derive E cfg B₁).h_F ≤ (derive E cfg B₂).h_F) :
    HasE1WeightBetween E (chainRows B₁) (chainRows B₂) ∨
      FGBlock.compatible (derive E cfg B₁).F (derive E cfg B₂).F = true := by
  have hlt : (derive E cfg B₁).h_F < (derive E cfg B₂).h :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hle (finalized_below_height E cfg B₂)
  rcases e1Weight_or_finalized_preceq E cfg B₁ B₂ hlt with hev | hF
  · exact Or.inl hev
  · exact Or.inr (compatible_of_preceq_common hF (derive_anchors_preceq E cfg B₂).1)

theorem e1Weight_or_finalized_preceq (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (B W : FGBlock V)
    (hh : (derive E cfg B).h_F < (derive E cfg W).h) :
    HasE1WeightBetween E (chainRows B) (chainRows W) ∨
      FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg B).F W := by
  by_cases hz : (derive E cfg B).h_F = 0
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    rw [finalized_zero_is_genesis E cfg B hz]
    exact genesis_preceq W
  · obtain ⟨F, -, rfl, Qf, hQf, hwf⟩ := finality_certificate E cfg B hz
    obtain ⟨X, hXW, -, Qc, hQc, hwc⟩ :=
      height_crossing E cfg W _ (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz) hh
    by_cases hr : X.root = (derive E cfg B).F.root
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [← FGBlock.root_injective hr]
      exact hXW
    · refine Or.inl ⟨Qf ∩ Qc, quorum_intersection E hQf hQc, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hf, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
      obtain ⟨cB, b, hcB, hb, hbi, hbf⟩ := hwf i hf
      obtain ⟨cW, a, hcW, ha, hai, ham⟩ := hwc i hc
      exact ⟨b, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hcB hb, a, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hcW ha, hbi, hai,
        e1Slashable_of_matchesEntry b a _ X.root _ (hbi.trans hai.symm) hbf ham hr⟩

theorem e1Weight_or_finalized_preceq_of_parent_roots (E : Electorate V)
    (H : FGHeightView V) (f : FGFinalityView V) (hc : FGCertificateLaws E H f)
    (B W : FGBlock V) (hr : RootInjectiveOn B.parent W.parent)
    (hh : (f B).h_F < (H W).h) :
    HasE1WeightBetween E (chainRows B) (chainRows W) ∨
      FGBlock.Preceq (f B).F W := by
  by_cases hz : (f B).h_F = 0
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    rw [hc.finalized_zero B hz]
    exact genesis_preceq W
  · obtain ⟨F, -, rfl, Qf, hQf, hwf⟩ := finality_certificate_of_certificate E H f hc B hz
    obtain ⟨X, hXW, hXh, Qc, hQc, hwc⟩ :=
      hc.height.height_crossing W _ (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz) hh
    by_cases he : X.root = (f B).F.root
    · have hXparent : FGBlock.Preceq X W.parent :=
        preceq_parent_of_ne hXW (fun h => hh.ne (hXh.symm.trans (congrArg (fun B => (H B).h) h)))
      have heq := hr X (f B).F (Or.inr hXparent)
        (Or.inl (finalized_preceq_parent_of_certificate E H f hc B)) he
      exact Or.inr (heq ▸ hXW)
    · refine Or.inl ⟨Qf ∩ Qc, quorum_intersection E hQf hQc, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hf, hcross⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
      obtain ⟨cB, b, hcB, hb, hbi, hbf⟩ := hwf i hf
      obtain ⟨cW, a, hcW, ha, hai, ham⟩ := hwc i hcross
      exact ⟨b, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hcB hb, a, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hcW ha, hbi, hai,
        e1Slashable_of_matchesEntry b a _ X.root _ (hbi.trans hai.symm) hbf ham he⟩

theorem exists_crossing_quorum_ne_justified (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (B W : FGBlock V)
    (hJ : (derive E cfg B).h_j ≠ 0)
    (hW : (derive E cfg B).h_j < (derive E cfg W).h)
    (hnot : ¬ FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg B).J W) :
    ∃ X : FGBlock V, X.root ≠ (derive E cfg B).J.root ∧ ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧
      ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ b ∈ chainRows W, b.signer = i ∧
        b.height_pair.matchesEntry (derive E cfg B).h_j X.root = true := by
  obtain ⟨X, hXW, -, Q, hQ, hw⟩ :=
    height_crossing E cfg W _ (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJ) hW
  refine ⟨X, fun hr => hnot ?_, Q, hQ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [← FGBlock.root_injective hr]
    exact hXW
  · obtain ⟨carrier, b, hc, hb, hbi, hm⟩ := hw i hi
    exact ⟨b, mem_chainRows_of_carrier hc hb, hbi, hm⟩

theorem exists_honest_timeout_of_crossing (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (faulty : Finset V)
    (B W : FGBlock V)
    (hcap : E.weightOf faulty + E.totalWeight < 2 * E.q)
    (hJ : (derive E cfg B).h_j ≠ 0)
    (hW : (derive E cfg B).h_j < (derive E cfg W).h)
    (hnot : ¬ FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg B).J W)
    (hhonest : ∀ a ∈ chainRows B, ∀ b ∈ chainRows W, a.signer ∉ faulty → ¬ Slashable a b) :
    ∃ i, i ∉ faulty ∧ ∃ X : BlockId, X ≠ (derive E cfg B).J.root ∧
      (∃ a ∈ chainRows B, a.signer = i ∧
        a.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg B).h_j (derive E cfg B).J.root false) ∧
      (∃ b ∈ chainRows W, b.signer = i ∧ b.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg B).h_j X true) := by
  obtain ⟨Qj, hQj, hwj⟩ := justification_certificate_rows E cfg B hJ
  obtain ⟨X, hne, Qc, hQc, hwc⟩ := exists_crossing_quorum_ne_justified E cfg B W hJ hW hnot
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hif⟩ := honest_in_intersection E faulty hQj hQc hcap
  obtain ⟨hij, hic⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
  obtain ⟨a, haB, hai, hap⟩ := hwj i hij
  obtain ⟨b, hbW, hbi, hm⟩ := hwc i hic
  refine ⟨i, hif, X.root, hne, ⟨a, haB, hai, hap⟩, b, hbW, hbi, ?_⟩
  cases hbp : b.height_pair with
  | empty => simp [hbp, NamedHeightPair.matchesEntry] at hm
  | vote k T t =>
      simp only [hbp, NamedHeightPair.matchesEntry, decide_eq_true_eq] at hm
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hm
      cases t with
      | true => rfl
      | false =>
          exfalso
          refine hhonest a haB b hbW (hai ▸ hif) ?_
          have h2 : e2Slashable a b = true := by
            simp [e2Slashable, sameSigner, e2Fields, hap, hbp, hai, hbi, Ne.symm hne]
          change slashable a b = true
          simp only [slashable, h2, Bool.or_true]

theorem filteredFrom_viable_child (c : Controls V) (blocks : Finset (FGBlock V))
    (hclosed : ∀ B ∈ blocks, ∀ A, FGBlock.Preceq A B → A ∈ blocks)
    (B : FGBlock V) (hB : B ∈ filteredFrom E cfg c blocks) (hlow : hOf E cfg B < c.lo) :
    ∃ C ∈ filteredFrom E cfg c blocks, C.parent = B := by
  obtain ⟨-, hF, hZ, W, hW, hBW, hlo⟩ := (mem_filteredFrom E cfg c blocks B).1 hB
  have hne : B ≠ W := by
    rintro rfl
    simp only [Height] at *
    omega
  obtain ⟨C, hCp, hCg, hCW⟩ := child_toward hBW hne
  have hBC : FGBlock.Preceq B C := by
    cases C with
    | genesis => exact absurd rfl hCg
    | node p s r rs =>
        simp only [FGBlock.parent] at hCp
        subst hCp
        exact preceq_parent_node p s r rs
  exact ⟨C, (mem_filteredFrom E cfg c blocks C).2
    ⟨hclosed W hW C hCW, preceq_trans hF hBC, preceq_trans hZ hBC, W, hW, hCW, hlo⟩, hCp⟩

theorem finality_certificate (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (D : FGBlock V)
    (hnz : (derive E cfg D).h_F ≠ 0) :
    ∃ F : FGBlock V, FGBlock.Preceq F D ∧ F = (derive E cfg D).F ∧
      ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧
        ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ carrier : FGBlock V, ∃ a : Row V,
          FGBlock.Preceq carrier D ∧ a ∈ carrier.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
          a.finality_pair = some ⟨(derive E cfg D).h_F, F.root⟩ := by
  refine ⟨_, (derive_anchors_preceq E cfg D).1, rfl, ?_⟩
  induction D with
  | genesis => exact absurd rfl hnz
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hF, hhF⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
      have hw := folded_witnesses E cfg p s x rs
      rw [derive_node] at hnz ⊢
      rcases finality_pair_cases E cfg (foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs) with
        ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, hf⟩
      · rw [h1, h2, hF, hhF]
        rw [h2, hhF] at hnz
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hw'⟩ := ih hnz
        refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hp⟩ := hw' i hi
        exact ⟨carrier, a, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs hc, ha, hs, hp⟩
      · rw [h1, h2]
        refine ⟨_, isQuorum_of_finalityReady E hf, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨a, ⟨carrier, hc, ha⟩, hs, hp⟩ := hw.finalize i hi
        exact ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hp⟩

theorem finality_first_inclusion_persist (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)

  obtain ⟨hk, hmP⟩ := finality_match_before E cfg hPW a fp hfp hbelow hm
  exact bit_from_row E cfg .finality P W s x rows a ha hCW hmP hk

end AvailableChain.KitFG

theorem finality_occurrence_history (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {u : Row V} {W P K : FGBlock V} {h z : Height} {t : BlockId} {χ : Bool}
    (_occ : u ∈ W.rows) (_path : FGBlock.Preceq W P)
    (r6 : u.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg W.parent).h t χ)
    (carried : u.height_pair = .vote h t χ)
    (form : u.finality_pair = some ⟨z, K.root⟩ ∧ z < h)
    (pending : (derive E cfg P).J = K ∧ (derive E cfg P).h_j = z ∧
      (derive E cfg P).h_F < z) :
    ∀ Z, FGBlock.Preceq W.parent Z → FGBlock.Preceq Z P →
      (derive E cfg Z).J = K ∧ (derive E cfg Z).h_j = z ∧
        (derive E cfg Z).h_F < z := by
  have hh := (NamedHeightPair.vote.inj (r6.symm.trans carried)).1
  have hbelow : z < (derive E cfg W.parent).h := hh ▸ form.2
  have hm : rowMatchesBit .finality (derive E cfg P) u := by
    exact ⟨pending.2.2.trans_eq pending.2.1.symm,
      by simpa only [pending.1, pending.2.1] using form.1⟩
  intro Z hWZ hZP
  obtain ⟨hkZ, hmZ⟩ := finality_match_before E cfg hZP u ⟨z, K.root⟩ form.1

private theorem finalized_height_mono (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {B W : FGBlock V} (hBW : FGBlock.Preceq B W) :
    (derive E cfg B).h_F ≤ (derive E cfg W).h_F := by
  induction W with
  | genesis =>
      obtain rfl := preceq_genesis.mp hBW
      exact le_refl _
  | node P s x rows ih =>
      by_cases heq : B = .node P s x rows
      · subst B
        exact le_refl _
      have hBP := preceq_parent_of_preceq_node hBW heq
      apply (ih hBP).trans
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hj, _, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg P) (.node P s x rows) rows
      rw [derive_node]
      rcases finality_pair_cases E cfg
          (foldRows (derive E cfg P) (.node P s x rows) rows) with h | h
      · rw [h.2, hf]
      · rw [h.2.1, hj]
        exact (chainOrder_derive E cfg P).heights_ordered

        exact ih (hhF.symm.trans (h2.symm.trans hz))
      · have := lt_of_finalityReady E hf

        omega

private theorem frameGeometry_lexMax_of_inv (H : FGHeightView V) (f : FGFinalityView V)
    (st : Store V) (hI : FGStoreInvariant H f st) :
    lexMaxView H st.F st.TF = (st.h_j, st.J) := by
  rw [lexMaxView_def]
  dsimp only
  let candidates := (st.TF.filter (fun W => FGBlock.preceq st.F (H W).J)).image
    (fun W => ((H W).h_j, (H W).J))
  have hmem : ∀ q, q ∈ candidates ↔
      ∃ W ∈ st.TF, FGBlock.Preceq st.F (H W).J ∧ ((H W).h_j, (H W).J) = q := by
    intro q
    simp only [candidates, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, FGBlock.Preceq, and_assoc]
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hFC, hj, hJ⟩ := hI.pair.1
  have hp : (st.h_j, st.J) ∈ candidates :=
    (hmem _).2 ⟨C, hC, hFC, by rw [hj, hJ]⟩
  have hsup : candidates.sup lexKey = lexKey (st.h_j, st.J) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨W, hW, hFW, rfl⟩ := (hmem q).1 hq
      exact hI.pair.2 W hW hFW
    · exact Finset.le_sup hp
  change (pickPair candidates (fun p => decide (lexKey p = candidates.sup lexKey))).getD
    (0, .genesis) = _
  rw [hsup, pickPair_eq_of_unique _ _ _ hp (by simp)]
  · rfl

    lexMaxView H st.F st.TF = (st.h_j, st.J) := by
  rw [lexMaxView_def]

    (fun W => ((H W).h_j, (H W).J))
  have hmem : ∀ q, q ∈ candidates ↔
      ∃ W ∈ st.TF, FGBlock.Preceq st.F (H W).J ∧ ((H W).h_j, (H W).J) = q := by

    (hmem _).2 ⟨C, hC, hFC, by rw [hj, hJ]⟩

    (hW : hOf E cfg W = st.h_max) (hn : ¬ FGBlock.Preceq st.J W) :
    ∃ U, FGBlock.Preceq U W ∧ hOf E cfg U < hOf E cfg W ∧
      ¬ (FGBlock.Preceq st.J (derive E cfg U).T_h ∨
        FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg U).T_h st.J) := by

  obtain ⟨U, hU, hh⟩ := frame_crossed_entry E cfg W st.h_j (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnz)
    (by rw [hW, htop]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  refine ⟨U, hU, by rw [hh, hW, htop]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _, ?_⟩
  intro hc
  have hJW : FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg U).T_h W :=
    preceq_trans (entry_preceq E cfg U) hU

    rw [hJ, entry_height E cfg K (fun hz => hnz (hj.trans hz))]
    exact hj.symm.trans hh.symm
  have heJ : (derive E cfg st.J).T_h = st.J := hJ ▸ J_is_entry E cfg K
  rcases hc with hc | hc
  · exact hn (preceq_trans hc hJW)
  · have he : (derive E cfg U).T_h = st.J := by
      have hp := entry_eq_on_plateau E cfg hc
        ((entry_same_height E cfg U).trans hhJ.symm)

theorem frame_facts (st : Store V) (h : StoreInv E cfg st) :
    let c := storeControls E cfg st
    c.j < c.H ∧
      (c.Z, c.lo) =
        (if c.H = c.j + 1 ∧ c.contest = false then (c.J, c.H - 1)
         else if c.contest then (st.F, c.H) else (st.F, c.H - 1)) ∧
      (c.lo = c.H - 1 ∨ c.lo = c.H) ∧
      (c.rootIsJ = true ↔ c.H = c.j + 1 ∧ c.contest = false) ∧
      ∀ K ∈ st.TF, (derive E cfg K).F = st.F →
        (derive E cfg K).h_F ≤ c.j ∧
          ((derive E cfg K).h_F < c.lo ∨
            (c.Z = c.J ∧ c.lo = c.j ∧ c.j = c.H - 1 ∧
              c.j + 1 = c.H ∧ FGBlock.Preceq st.F c.J)) := by
  let c := storeControls E cfg st
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀, hK₀F⟩ := h.Fcar
  obtain ⟨L, hL, -, hp, hmax⟩ := lexMax_spec E cfg st.F st.TF
    (viewRootInj_all st.TF) ⟨K₀, hK₀, hK₀F ▸ derive_F_preceq_J E cfg K₀⟩
  have hj : c.j = (derive E cfg L).h_j := congrArg Prod.fst (h.pair.trans hp)
  have hjH : c.j < c.H := by
    rw [hj]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (justified_below_height E cfg L)
      (show (derive E cfg L).h ≤ st.h_max by
        rw [h.hmax]
        exact le_frontier E cfg hL)
  have hFj : ∀ K ∈ st.TF, (derive E cfg K).F = st.F →
      (derive E cfg K).h_F ≤ c.j := by
    intro K hK hKF
    rw [hj]
    exact le_trans (heights_ordered E cfg K)
      (fst_le_of_lexKey_le (hmax K hK (hKF ▸ derive_F_preceq_J E cfg K)))
  have hroot : c.rootIsJ = true ↔ c.H = c.j + 1 ∧ c.contest = false := by
    unfold Controls.rootIsJ
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.not_eq_true']
  have htable : (c.Z, c.lo) =
      (if c.H = c.j + 1 ∧ c.contest = false then (c.J, c.H - 1)
       else if c.contest then (st.F, c.H) else (st.F, c.H - 1)) := by
    have hF : c.F = st.F := rfl
    unfold Controls.Z Controls.lo Controls.rootIsJ
    by_cases hc : c.contest = true
    · simp [hc, hF]
    · have hc : c.contest = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc
      by_cases htop : c.H = c.j + 1 <;>
        simp [hc, htop, hF]
  refine ⟨hjH, htable, ?_, hroot, ?_⟩
  · unfold Controls.lo
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
  · intro K hK hKF
    have hle := hFj K hK hKF
    refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
    by_cases hlt : (derive E cfg K).h_F < c.lo
    · exact Or.inl hlt
    · have hc : c.contest = false := by
        cases heq : c.contest with
        | false => rfl
        | true =>
            have hlo : c.lo = c.H := by unfold Controls.lo; rw [heq]; rfl
            rw [hlo] at hlt
            exact False.elim (hlt (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hjH))
      have hlo : c.lo = c.H - 1 := by unfold Controls.lo; rw [hc]; rfl
      have htop : c.H = c.j + 1 := by
        simp only [Height] at *
        omega
      have hZ : c.Z = c.J := by
        unfold Controls.Z
        rw [hroot.mpr ⟨htop, hc⟩]
        rfl
      have hjH₁ : c.j = c.H - 1 := by rw [htop, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact Or.inr ⟨hZ, hlo.trans hjH₁.symm, hjH₁, htop.symm, h.FJ⟩

theorem heightBridge_of_refinement
    (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {Ω : Type} (π : Ω → FGHeight V)
    (initial : Ω)
    (step : Ω → FGBlock V → List (Row V) → Ω)
    (d : FGBlock V → Ω)
    (href : HeightFoldRefinement E cfg π initial step d) :
    HeightBridge E cfg (fun B => π (d B)) := by
  intro B
  change π (d B) = heightOf (derive E cfg B)
  induction B with
  | genesis =>
      rw [href.derive_genesis]
      exact href.initial_height
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      rw [href.derive_node]
      exact href.step_height (d p) (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs ih

theorem height_crossing (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (C : FGBlock V) (h : Height)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ h) (hlt : h < (derive E cfg C).h) :
    ∃ X : FGBlock V, FGBlock.Preceq X C ∧ (derive E cfg X).h = h ∧
      ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧
        ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ carrier : FGBlock V, ∃ a : Row V,
          FGBlock.Preceq carrier C ∧ a ∈ carrier.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
          a.height_pair.matchesEntry h X.root = true := by
  induction C with
  | genesis =>
      change h < 1 at hlt
      simp only [Height] at *
      omega
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      by_cases hp : h < (derive E cfg p).h
      · obtain ⟨X, hX, hXh, Q, hQ, hw⟩ := ih hp
        refine ⟨X, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs hX, hXh, Q, hQ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hm⟩ := hw i hi
        exact ⟨carrier, a, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs hc, ha, hs, hm⟩
      · have hParent : (derive E cfg p).h = h := by
          rcases derive_node_height_cases E cfg p s x rs with h1 | h1 <;>
            (simp only [Height] at *; omega)
        have hAdvance : (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h ≠ (derive E cfg p).h := by
          simp only [Height] at *; omega
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hw⟩ := crossing_matching_quorum E cfg p s x rs hAdvance
        refine ⟨(derive E cfg p).T_h, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs (entry_preceq E cfg p),
          (entry_same_height E cfg p).trans hParent, Q, hQ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hm⟩ := hw i hi
        rw [hParent] at hm
        exact ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hm⟩

theorem height_occurrence_keys (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {u : Row V} {W P U : FGBlock V} {y : Height} {χ : Bool}
    (occ : u ∈ W.rows) (path : FGBlock.Preceq W P)
    (r6 : u.height_pair =
      .vote (derive E cfg W.parent).h (derive E cfg W.parent).T_h.root χ)
    (name : u.height_pair = .vote y U.root χ)
    (entry : (derive E cfg U).h = y ∧ (derive E cfg U).T_h = U)
    (endpoint : (derive E cfg P).h = y) :
    FGBlock.Preceq U W.parent ∧
      (derive E cfg W.parent).h = (derive E cfg P).h ∧
      (derive E cfg W.parent).T_h.root = (derive E cfg P).T_h.root := by
  have hparent : FGBlock.Preceq W.parent P := by
    cases W with
    | genesis => simp [FGBlock.rows] at occ
    | node p s x rows => exact preceq_trans (preceq_parent_node p s x rows) path
  obtain ⟨hh, ht, _⟩ := NamedHeightPair.vote.inj (r6.symm.trans name)
  have hT : (derive E cfg W.parent).T_h = U := FGBlock.root_injective ht
  have hU : FGBlock.Preceq U W.parent := by
    rw [← entry.2, ← hT, entry_idem]
    exact entry_preceq E cfg W.parent
  have hk := hh.trans endpoint.symm
  exact ⟨hU, hk, congrArg FGBlock.root (entry_eq_on_plateau E cfg hparent hk)⟩

theorem justification_certificate (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (D : FGBlock V)
    (hnz : (derive E cfg D).h_j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Q : Finset V, E.IsQuorum Q ∧ ∀ i ∈ Q, ∃ carrier a,
      FGBlock.Preceq carrier D ∧ a ∈ carrier.rows ∧ a.signer = i ∧
      a.height_pair = .vote (derive E cfg D).h_j (derive E cfg D).J.root false := by
  induction D with
  | genesis => exact absurd rfl hnz
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      obtain ⟨-, hh, hT, hJ, hhj, -, -⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
      have hw := folded_witnesses E cfg p s x rs
      rw [derive_node] at hnz ⊢
      rcases justification_pair_cases E cfg (foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs)
        with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, hq⟩
      · rw [h1, h2, hJ, hhj]
        rw [h2, hhj] at hnz
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hw'⟩ := ih hnz
        refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hp⟩ := hw' i hi
        exact ⟨carrier, a, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs hc, ha, hs, hp⟩
      · rw [h1, h2]
        refine ⟨_, hq, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨a, ⟨carrier, hc, ha⟩, hs, hp⟩ := hw.target i hi
        exact ⟨carrier, a, hc, ha, hs, hp⟩

theorem justification_eq_on_plateau (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {D P : FGBlock V} (hDP : FGBlock.Preceq D P)
    (hh : (derive E cfg D).h = (derive E cfg P).h) :
    (derive E cfg P).J = (derive E cfg D).J ∧
      (derive E cfg P).h_j = (derive E cfg D).h_j := by
  induction P with
  | genesis =>
      obtain rfl := preceq_genesis.mp hDP
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      by_cases hsame : D = .node p s x rs
      · subst D
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have hDp := preceq_parent_of_preceq_node hDP hsame
        have hlow := h_mono E cfg hDp
        have hhigh := h_mono E cfg (preceq_parent_node p s x rs)
        have hpar : (derive E cfg p).h = (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h := by
          simp only [Height] at *; omega
        obtain ⟨hJ, hj⟩ := ih hDp (hh.trans hpar.symm)
        obtain ⟨-, hfold, -, hfoldJ, hfoldj, -⟩ :=
          foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        rw [derive_node, process_height_events_eq] at hpar ⊢
        split_ifs at hpar ⊢
        · change (derive E cfg p).h = (afterFin E _).h + 1 at hpar
          rw [afterFin_h, hfold] at hpar
          simp only [Height] at *; omega
        · change (derive E cfg p).h = (afterFin E _).h + 1 at hpar
          rw [afterFin_h, hfold] at hpar
          simp only [Height] at *; omega
        · exact ⟨((afterFin_J E _).trans hfoldJ).trans hJ,
            ((afterFin_h_j E _).trans hfoldj).trans hj⟩

end AvailableChain.KitFG

private theorem low_justification_stable (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    {B W : FGBlock V} (hBW : FGBlock.Preceq B W)
    (hlow : (derive E cfg W).h_j < (derive E cfg B).h) :
    (derive E cfg W).J = (derive E cfg B).J ∧
      (derive E cfg W).h_j = (derive E cfg B).h_j := by
  induction W with
  | genesis =>
      obtain rfl := preceq_genesis.mp hBW
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | node P s x rows ih =>
      by_cases heq : B = .node P s x rows
      · subst B
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      have hBP := preceq_parent_of_preceq_node hBW heq
      obtain ⟨_, hh, _, hJ, hj, _, _⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg P) (.node P s x rows) rows
      rcases justification_pair_cases E cfg
          (foldRows (derive E cfg P) (.node P s x rows) rows) with h | h
      · have hJ' : (derive E cfg (.node P s x rows)).J = (derive E cfg P).J := by
          rw [derive_node, h.1, hJ]
        have hj' : (derive E cfg (.node P s x rows)).h_j = (derive E cfg P).h_j := by
          rw [derive_node, h.2, hj]
        obtain ⟨hJB, hjB⟩ := ih hBP (hj' ▸ hlow)
        exact ⟨hJ'.trans hJB, hj'.trans hjB⟩
      · have hj' : (derive E cfg (.node P s x rows)).h_j = (derive E cfg P).h := by
          rw [derive_node, h.2.1, hh]
        have hm := h_mono E cfg hBP
        rw [hj'] at hlow
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hm hlow)

theorem noHighContest : NoHighContestStatement := by
  intro V _ _ _ E cfg h0 entry faulty A F vw hcap hrows hhigh hcontest
  change (decide (frontier E cfg vw = (lexMax E cfg F vw).1 + 1) &&
    decide (∃ W ∈ vw, hOf E cfg W = frontier E cfg vw ∧
      ¬ FGBlock.Preceq (lexMax E cfg F vw).2 W)) = true at hcontest
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcontest
  obtain ⟨hH, W, hW, hWh, hnot⟩ := hcontest
  change frontier E cfg vw ≤ h0
  by_contra hbound
  have hj : h0 ≤ (lexMax E cfg F vw).1 := by
    simp only [Height] at hH hbound ⊢
    omega
  by_cases hex : ∃ K ∈ vw, FGBlock.Preceq F (derive E cfg K).J
  · obtain ⟨K, hK, _, hlex, _⟩ := lexMax_spec E cfg F vw (viewRootInj_all vw) hex
    rw [hlex] at hH hj hnot
    dsimp only at hH hj hnot
    by_cases hz : (derive E cfg K).h_j = 0
    · rw [justified_zero_is_genesis E cfg K hz] at hnot
      exact hnot (genesis_preceq W)
    · obtain ⟨Qj, hQj, hwj⟩ := justification_certificate E cfg K hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hif⟩ := honest_in_quorum E faulty hQj hcap
      obtain ⟨carrier, a, hac, ha, hai, hap⟩ := hwj i hi
      have hJ := (hhigh a (hrows K hK (mem_chainRows_of_carrier hac ha))
        (hai ▸ hif) _ _ false hap hj).1
      have hlt : (derive E cfg K).h_j < (derive E cfg W).h := by
        change (derive E cfg W).h = frontier E cfg vw at hWh
        simp only [Height] at hWh hH ⊢
        omega
      obtain ⟨X, hXW, _, Qx, hQx, hwx⟩ :=
        height_crossing E cfg W _ (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz) hlt
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkf⟩ := honest_in_quorum E faulty hQx hcap
      obtain ⟨crossing, b, hbc, hb, hbk, hbp⟩ := hwx k hk
      have hbA := hrows W hW (mem_chainRows_of_carrier hbc hb)
      cases hp : b.height_pair with
      | empty =>
          rw [hp] at hbp
          change false = true at hbp
          cases hbp
      | vote g T timeout =>
          rw [hp] at hbp
          change decide (g = (derive E cfg K).h_j ∧ T = X.root) = true at hbp
          have hm := of_decide_eq_true hbp
          have hX := (hhigh b hbA (hbk ▸ hkf) g T timeout hp (hm.1 ▸ hj)).1
          have hroot : X.root = (derive E cfg K).J.root := by
            rw [← hm.2, hX, hm.1, hJ]
          exact hnot ((FGBlock.root_injective hroot) ▸ hXW)
  · have hlex := lexMax_of_none E cfg F vw (fun K hK hFK => hex ⟨K, hK, hFK⟩)
    rw [hlex] at hnot
    exact hnot (genesis_preceq W)

end AvailableChain.KitFG
end

          simp only [FGBlock.preceq, hA, Bool.or_true]

theorem progress_from_row_of_bridge
    (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    (v : FGHeightView V) (hb : HeightBridge E cfg v)
    {P W : FGBlock V} {s : Slot} {x : Nat} {rs : List (Row V)} {a : Row V}
    (ha : a ∈ rs)
    (hCW : FGBlock.Preceq (.node P s x rs) W)
    (hm : a.height_pair.matchesEntry (v P).h (v P).T_h.root = true)
    (hh : (v P).h = (v W).h) :
    a.signer ∈ (v W).progress := by
  have heq : ∀ B, v B = heightOf (derive E cfg B) := hb
  have hT := (heightLaws_of_bridge E cfg v hb).entry_plateau

theorem simplexSelectionLaws (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) :
    FGSelectionLaws E (simplexHeightView E cfg) (simplexFinalityView E cfg)
      (simplexSelectionView E cfg) where
  initial := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  ordered := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | node p s x rs =>
        change (simplexPending _).Pairwise _
        rw [simplexPending_def]
        split_ifs <;> simp
  bounds := by
    intro B e he
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change e ∈ simplexPending σ at he
        rw [simplexPending_def] at he
        split_ifs at he with hpend
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
          obtain ⟨_, _, _, hJ, hj, _, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
          change (derive E cfg p).h_F < σ.h_j ∧ σ.h_j ≤ (derive E cfg p).h_j ∧
            FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg p).F σ.J ∧ FGBlock.Preceq σ.J (derive E cfg p).J
          have hpend' : (derive E cfg p).h_F < (derive E cfg p).h_j :=
            hf ▸ hpend.trans_eq hj
          rw [hj, hJ]
          exact ⟨hpend', le_rfl, derive_F_preceq_J E cfg p, preceq_refl _⟩
        · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
  entry_origin := simplex_prefinal_entry_origin E cfg
  none_iff := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis =>
        change (none : Option (FGCertEntry V)) = none ↔
          ∀ e ∈ ([] : List (FGCertEntry V)), ¬ E.IsQuorum e.Q
        simp
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change (if finalityReady E σ then some _ else none) = none ↔
          ∀ e ∈ simplexPending σ, ¬ E.IsQuorum e.Q
        by_cases hr : finalityReady E σ = true
        · rw [ite_eq_left hr]
          constructor
          · intro h; cases h
          · intro h
            have he : (⟨σ.h_j, σ.J, σ.finalize⟩ : FGCertEntry V) ∈ simplexPending σ := by
              rw [simplexPending_def, ite_eq_left (lt_of_finalityReady E hr)]
              exact List.mem_singleton_self _
            exact (h _ he (isQuorum_of_finalityReady E hr)).elim
        · rw [ite_eq_right hr]
          constructor
          · intro _ e he hq
            rw [simplexPending_def] at he
            split_ifs at he with hp
            · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
              apply hr
              change (decide (σ.h_F < σ.h_j) && decide (E.q ≤ E.weightOf σ.finalize)) = true
              simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
              exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
            · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
          · intro _; rfl
  greatest := by
    intro B e he
    cases B with
    | genesis => cases he
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change (if finalityReady E σ then some _ else none) = some e at he
        split_ifs at he with hready
        · obtain rfl := Option.some.inj he
          change _ ∈ simplexPending σ ∧ E.IsQuorum σ.finalize ∧
            ∀ d ∈ simplexPending σ, E.IsQuorum d.Q → d.j ≤ σ.h_j
          rw [simplexPending_def, ite_eq_left (lt_of_finalityReady E hready)]
          exact ⟨List.mem_singleton_self _, isQuorum_of_finalityReady E hready,
            fun d hd _ => (List.mem_singleton.mp hd) ▸ le_rfl⟩
  write := by
    intro B hn
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (hn rfl).elim
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hF, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change (⟨(derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).F,
          (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h_F⟩ : FGFinality V) =
          match (if finalityReady E σ then
            some (⟨σ.h_j, σ.J, σ.finalize⟩ : FGCertEntry V) else none) with
          | none => _
          | some e => _
        rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).1,
          (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2, afterFin_F, afterFin_h_F]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · exact congrArg₂ FGFinality.mk hF hf
  prune := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis => rfl
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change simplexPending (afterFin E σ) =
          (simplexPending σ).filter (fun e => decide ((derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h_F < e.j))
        rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2]
        simp only [simplexPending_def, afterFin_h_j, afterFin_J, afterFin_finalize, afterFin_h_F]
        by_cases hr : finalityReady E σ = true
        · have hp := lt_of_finalityReady E hr
          simp only [hr, ite_true, hp, Nat.lt_irrefl, ite_false, List.filter_cons,
            decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, List.filter_nil]
        · simp only [hr]
          split_ifs with hp <;> simp_all
  pruned_covered := by
    intro B e he hle
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
    | node p s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s x rs) rs
        change e ∈ simplexPending σ at he
        rw [simplexPending_def] at he
        split_ifs at he with hpend
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
          change σ.h_j ≤ (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).h_F at hle
          change FGBlock.Preceq σ.J (derive E cfg (.node p s x rs)).F
          rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2, afterFin_h_F] at hle
          rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).1, afterFin_F]
          split_ifs with hr
          · exact preceq_refl _
          · rw [ite_eq_right hr] at hle
            exact (Nat.not_le_of_lt hpend hle).elim
        · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim

theorem simplexSelectionLaws (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) :
    FGSelectionLaws E (simplexHeightView E cfg) (simplexFinalityView E cfg)
      (simplexSelectionView E cfg) where
  initial := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  ordered := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        change (simplexPending _).Pairwise _
        rw [simplexPending_def]
        split_ifs <;> simp
  bounds := by
    intro B e he
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change e ∈ simplexPending σ at he
        rw [simplexPending_def] at he
        split_ifs at he with hpend
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
          obtain ⟨_, _, _, hJ, hj, _, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs)
            rs
          change (derive E cfg p).h_F < σ.h_j ∧ σ.h_j ≤ (derive E cfg p).h_j ∧
            FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg p).F σ.J ∧ FGBlock.Preceq σ.J (derive E cfg p).J
          have hpend' : (derive E cfg p).h_F < (derive E cfg p).h_j :=
            hf ▸ hpend.trans_eq hj
          rw [hj, hJ]
          exact ⟨hpend', le_rfl, derive_F_preceq_J E cfg p, preceq_refl _⟩
        · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
  entry_origin := simplex_prefinal_entry_origin E cfg
  none_iff := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis =>
        change (none : Option (FGCertEntry V)) = none ↔
          ∀ e ∈ ([] : List (FGCertEntry V)), ¬ E.IsQuorum e.Q
        simp
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change (if finalityReady E σ then some _ else none) = none ↔
          ∀ e ∈ simplexPending σ, ¬ E.IsQuorum e.Q
        by_cases hr : finalityReady E σ = true
        · rw [ite_eq_left hr]
          constructor
          · intro h; cases h
          · intro h
            have he : (⟨σ.h_j, σ.J, σ.finalize⟩ : FGCertEntry V) ∈ simplexPending σ := by
              rw [simplexPending_def, ite_eq_left (lt_of_finalityReady E hr)]
              exact List.mem_singleton_self _
            exact (h _ he (isQuorum_of_finalityReady E hr)).elim
        · rw [ite_eq_right hr]
          constructor
          · intro _ e he hq
            rw [simplexPending_def] at he
            split_ifs at he with hp
            · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
              apply hr
              change (decide (σ.h_F < σ.h_j) && decide (E.q ≤ E.weightOf σ.finalize)) = true
              simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
              exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
            · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
          · intro _; rfl
  greatest := by
    intro B e he
    cases B with
    | genesis => cases he
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change (if finalityReady E σ then some _ else none) = some e at he
        split_ifs at he with hready
        · obtain rfl := Option.some.inj he
          change _ ∈ simplexPending σ ∧ E.IsQuorum σ.finalize ∧
            ∀ d ∈ simplexPending σ, E.IsQuorum d.Q → d.j ≤ σ.h_j
          rw [simplexPending_def, ite_eq_left (lt_of_finalityReady E hready)]
          exact ⟨List.mem_singleton_self _, isQuorum_of_finalityReady E hready,
            fun d hd _ => (List.mem_singleton.mp hd) ▸ le_rfl⟩
  write := by
    intro B hn
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (hn rfl).elim
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hF, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change (⟨(derive E cfg (.node p s r_s x rs)).F,
          (derive E cfg (.node p s r_s x rs)).h_F⟩ : FGFinality V) =
          match (if finalityReady E σ then
            some (⟨σ.h_j, σ.J, σ.finalize⟩ : FGCertEntry V) else none) with
          | none => _
          | some e => _
        rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).1,
          (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2, afterFin_F, afterFin_h_F]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · exact congrArg₂ FGFinality.mk hF hf
  prune := by
    intro B
    cases B with
    | genesis => rfl
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change simplexPending (afterFin E σ) =
          (simplexPending σ).filter (fun e => decide ((derive E cfg (.node p s r_s x rs)).h_F <
            e.j))
        rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2]
        simp only [simplexPending_def, afterFin_h_j, afterFin_J, afterFin_finalize, afterFin_h_F]
        by_cases hr : finalityReady E σ = true
        · have hp := lt_of_finalityReady E hr
          simp only [hr, ite_true, hp, Nat.lt_irrefl, ite_false, List.filter_cons,
            decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, List.filter_nil]
        · simp only [hr]
          split_ifs with hp <;> simp_all
  pruned_covered := by
    intro B e he hle
    cases B with
    | genesis => exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim
    | node p s r_s x rs =>
        let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) (.node p s r_s x rs) rs
        change e ∈ simplexPending σ at he
        rw [simplexPending_def] at he
        split_ifs at he with hpend
        · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.mp he
          change σ.h_j ≤ (derive E cfg (.node p s r_s x rs)).h_F at hle
          change FGBlock.Preceq σ.J (derive E cfg (.node p s r_s x rs)).F
          rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).2, afterFin_h_F] at hle
          rw [derive_node, (process_height_events_F E cfg σ).1, afterFin_F]
          split_ifs with hr
          · exact preceq_refl _
          · rw [ite_eq_right hr] at hle
            exact (Nat.not_le_of_lt hpend hle).elim
        · exact (List.not_mem_nil he).elim

        simplexPending (if finalityReady E σ then { σ with F := σ.J, h_F := σ.h_j } else σ)

theorem simplexStoreInvariant (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig) (st : Store V)
    (hi : StoreInv E cfg st) :

  refine ⟨hi.closed, hi.gen, hi.Fmem, hi.hmax, ?_, hi.FJ, hi.Fcar⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDF⟩ := hi.Fcar
  have hDJ : FGBlock.Preceq st.F (derive E cfg D).J :=
    hDF ▸ derive_F_preceq_J E cfg D
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hFC, hpair, hmax⟩ :=
    lexMax_spec E cfg st.F st.TF (viewRootInj_all _) ⟨D, hD, hDJ⟩
  have heq := hi.pair.trans hpair
  refine ⟨⟨C, hC, hFC, congrArg Prod.fst heq, congrArg Prod.snd heq⟩, ?_⟩
  intro B hB hFB
  change lexKey ((derive E cfg B).h_j, (derive E cfg B).J) ≤ lexKey (st.h_j, st.J)
  rw [heq]
  exact hmax B hB hFB

theorem simplex_finality_origin (E : Electorate V) (cfg : FGConfig)
    (B : FGBlock V) (hnz : (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).h_F ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C D, StrictPrefix C D ∧ FGBlock.Preceq D B ∧
      JustificationBirth E (simplexHeightView E cfg) C
        (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).h_F (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).F ∧
      (simplexFinalityView E cfg D.parent).h_F < (simplexFinalityView E cfg D).h_F ∧
      simplexFinalityView E cfg D = simplexFinalityView E cfg B ∧
      FinalityQCAfter E C D
        (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).h_F (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).F := by
  induction B with
  | genesis => exact (hnz rfl).elim
  | node p s x rs ih =>
      let B := FGBlock.node p s x rs
      let σ := foldRows (derive E cfg p) B rs
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hJ, hj, hF, hf⟩ := foldRows_fields (derive E cfg p) B rs
      rcases finality_pair_cases E cfg σ with h | h
      · have hp : simplexFinalityView E cfg B = simplexFinalityView E cfg p := by
          change (⟨(derive E cfg B).F, (derive E cfg B).h_F⟩ : FGFinality V) = _
          rw [derive_node, h.1, h.2, hF, hf]
          rfl
        rw [hp] at hnz ⊢
        obtain ⟨C, D, hCD, hDp, hb, hinc, heq, hw⟩ := ih hnz
        exact ⟨C, D, hCD, preceq_node_of_preceq s x rs hDp, hb, hinc, heq, hw⟩
      · have hp : simplexFinalityView E cfg B = ⟨σ.J, σ.h_j⟩ := by
          change (⟨(derive E cfg B).F, (derive E cfg B).h_F⟩ : FGFinality V) = _
          rw [derive_node, h.1, h.2.1]
        have hpend := lt_of_finalityReady E h.2.2
        have he : (⟨σ.h_j, σ.J, σ.finalize⟩ : FGCertEntry V) ∈
            (simplexSelectionView E cfg).before B := by
          change _ ∈ simplexPending σ
          rw [simplexPending_def, ite_eq_left hpend]
          exact List.mem_singleton_self _
        obtain ⟨C, hCB, hb, hw⟩ := simplex_prefinal_entry_origin E cfg B _ he
        refine ⟨C, B, hCB, preceq_refl _, ?_, ?_, rfl, ?_⟩
        · change JustificationBirth E (simplexHeightView E cfg) C
            (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).h_F (simplexFinalityView E cfg B).F
          rw [hp]
          exact hb
        · rw [hp]
          change (derive E cfg p).h_F < σ.h_j
          exact hf ▸ hpend
        · rw [hp]
          exact ⟨σ.finalize, isQuorum_of_finalityReady E h.2.2, hw⟩

    (hc : ∀ W ∈ st.TF, ∀ U, FGBlock.Preceq U W → hOf E cfg U < hOf E cfg W →
      FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg U).T_h B ∨ FGBlock.Preceq B (derive E cfg U).T_h)
    (ht : (storeControls E cfg st).contest = true) :
    FGBlock.Preceq B st.J ∧ ∀ W ∈ st.TF, hOf E cfg W = st.h_max →
      ¬ FGBlock.Preceq st.J W → FGBlock.Preceq B W := by
  have ht' := ht
  change (decide (st.h_max = st.h_j + 1) && decide _) = true at ht'
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at ht'
  obtain ⟨htop, W₀, hW₀, hh₀, hn₀⟩ := ht'
  have step : ∀ W ∈ st.TF, hOf E cfg W = st.h_max → ¬ FGBlock.Preceq st.J W →
      FGBlock.Preceq B st.J ∧ FGBlock.Preceq B W := by
    intro W hW hh hn
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hlt, hbad⟩ := frame_contest_crossing E cfg st h htop W hh hn
    have hBW : FGBlock.Preceq B (derive E cfg U).T_h := by
      rcases hc W hW U hU hlt with hu | hu
      · rcases hJ with hj | hj
        · exact (hbad (preceq_total_of_common hj hu)).elim
        · exact (hbad (Or.inr (preceq_trans hu hj))).elim
      · exact hu
    have hBJ : FGBlock.Preceq B st.J := by
      rcases hJ with hj | hj
      · exact (hbad (Or.inl (preceq_trans hj hBW))).elim
      · exact hj
    exact ⟨hBJ, preceq_trans hBW (preceq_trans (entry_preceq E cfg U) hU)⟩
  exact ⟨(step W₀ hW₀ hh₀ hn₀).1, fun W hW hh hn => (step W hW hh hn).2⟩

theorem storeFrame_retention_of_compatible (st : Store V) (h : StoreInv E cfg st)
    (B : FGBlock V) (hB : B ∈ st.TF) (hFB : FGBlock.Preceq st.F B)
    (hJ : FGBlock.Preceq st.J B ∨ FGBlock.Preceq B st.J)
    (hc : ∀ W ∈ st.TF, ∀ U, FGBlock.Preceq U W → hOf E cfg U < hOf E cfg W →
      FGBlock.Preceq (derive E cfg U).T_h B ∨ FGBlock.Preceq B (derive E cfg U).T_h) :
    FGBlock.Preceq B (storeControls E cfg st).Z ∨
      B ∈ filteredFrom E cfg (storeControls E cfg st) st.TF := by
  let c := storeControls E cfg st
  by_cases hBZ : FGBlock.Preceq B c.Z
  · exact Or.inl hBZ
  right
  have hZB : FGBlock.Preceq c.Z B := by
    change FGBlock.Preceq (if c.rootIsJ then st.J else st.F) B
    cases hr : c.rootIsJ
    · exact hFB
    · rcases hJ with hj | hj
      · exact hj
      · exact (hBZ (by
          change FGBlock.Preceq B (if c.rootIsJ then st.J else st.F)
          rw [hr]; exact hj)).elim
  apply (mem_filteredFrom E cfg c st.TF B).2
  refine ⟨hB, hFB, hZB, ?_⟩
  cases ht : c.contest with
  | true =>
    have hx := storeFrame_contest_of_compatible E cfg st h B hJ hc ht
    have ht' := ht
    change (decide (st.h_max = st.h_j + 1) && decide _) = true at ht'
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at ht'
    obtain ⟨_, W, hW, hh, hn⟩ := ht'
    exact ⟨W, hW, hx.2 W hW hh hn, hh ▸ Controls.lo_le_H c⟩
  | false =>
    have hlo : c.lo = st.h_max - 1 := by change (if c.contest then _ else _) = _; rw [ht]; rfl
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hh⟩ := exists_frontier E cfg st.TF ⟨_, h.gen⟩
    have hw : hOf E cfg W = st.h_max := hh.trans h.hmax.symm
    by_cases hsmall : st.h_max ≤ 1
    · exact ⟨B, hB, preceq_refl B, by rw [hlo]; simp only [Height] at *; omega⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hu⟩ := frame_crossed_entry E cfg W (st.h_max - 1)
      (by simp only [Height] at *; omega) (by simp only [Height] at *; omega)
    rcases hc W hW U hU (by simp only [Height] at *; omega) with heB | hBe
    · refine ⟨B, hB, preceq_refl B, ?_⟩
      have hm := h_mono E cfg heB
      rw [entry_same_height] at hm
      exact hlo.trans hu.symm ▸ hm
    · exact ⟨W, hW, preceq_trans hBe (preceq_trans (entry_preceq E cfg U) hU),
        by rw [hlo, hw]; simp only [Height] at *; omega⟩

theorem viewLock_of_honest_chains : ViewLockOfHonestChainsStatement := by
  intro V _ _ _ E cfg K Fb vw θ faulty hKF hθ hweight hnoSlash
  apply viewLock_of_chains E cfg K Fb vw θ hKF hθ
  intro W hW hev
  obtain ⟨S, hS, he⟩ := hev
  have hsub : S ⊆ faulty := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hai, _, hab⟩ := he i hi
    by_contra hif
    exact hnoSlash W hW a ha b hb (by simpa only [hai] using hif) hab
  have hw : E.weightOf S ≤ E.weightOf faulty := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub
  change 2 * E.q ≤ E.totalWeight + E.weightOf S at hS
  omega

end AvailableChain.KitFG

theorem cleanRunPath_accessible {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V]
    (p : Params) (rho : Run V (sapc p)) (index : Nat) (b : Block)
    (hb : cleanRunPath p rho index b) : b = .genesis ∨
      ∃ v ∈ rho.honest, ∃ i, i ≤ index ∧
        pathKnown (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) b = true := by
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
  by_cases hg : b = .genesis
  · exact Or.inl hg
  right
  have stored (v : V) (hv : v ∈ rho.honest) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ index)
      (c : Block) (hc : c ∈ (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v).base.blocks)
      (hp : Block.Preceq b c) :
      ∃ v ∈ rho.honest, ∃ i, i ≤ index ∧
        pathKnown (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) b = true := by
    exact ⟨v, hv, i, hi, stored_pathKnown_at_fold p (rho.events.take i) v b
      ((paths_at_fold p _ v).1 c hc b hg hp)⟩
  have known (v : V) (hv : v ∈ rho.honest) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ index)
      (c : Block) (hc : pathKnown (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) c = true)
      (hp : Block.Preceq b c) :
      ∃ v ∈ rho.honest, ∃ i, i ≤ index ∧
        pathKnown (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) b = true := by
    have hm : c ∈ (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v).base.blocks := by
      cases c with
      | genesis => exact of_decide_eq_true hc
      | node parent slot root => exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).1
    exact stored v hv i hi c hm hp
  have pc (v : V) (hv : v ∈ rho.honest) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ index)
      (c : PC p.n) (hc : pcValid p (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) c = true)
      (hp : Block.Preceq b c.target) :
      ∃ v ∈ rho.honest, ∃ i, i ≤ index ∧
        pathKnown (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i v) b = true :=
    known v hv i hi c.target
      (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).1).2).1 hp
  rcases hb with hgen | ⟨c, source, hp⟩
  · exact (hg hgen).elim
  cases source with
  | genuine j hj v hv r c _ hc =>
    rcases @GridCO.confirmation_mem GridCO.slowLeasePolicy p.engine p.n _ r c hc
      with hgen | hm
    · subst c
      exact (hg (by simpa [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq] using hp)).elim
    · exact stored v hv j (by omega) c hm hp
  | timely r c _ source =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, j, hj, _, saved⟩ := source
    obtain ⟨k, hk, _, candidate⟩ := savedTimely_origin_before p rho (j + 1) v r c saved
    have candidate := timelyCandidate_of_timelyInput p _
      (base_receiptStamped_at_fold p _ v) (archiveStamped_at_fold p _ v) r c _ candidate
    have path := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp candidate).1).2
    have mem : c ∈ (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho k v).base.blocks := by
      cases c with
      | genesis => exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp path).1
      | node parent slot root =>
        exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp
          (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp path).1).1
    exact stored v hv k (by omega) c mem hp
  | gate j hj v hv _ c _ _ hc =>
    exact pc v hv j hj.le c (installedPC_valid_before p rho v j c hc) hp
  | proposal j hj v hv _ c _ _ hc =>
    rw [clock_bestPC] at hc
    exact pc v hv j hj.le c (installedPC_valid_before p rho v j c hc) hp
  | head j hj v hv r c _ _ hc =>
    have valid := certificates_valid_at_fold p (rho.events.take j) v
    have hc' := selectedPC_valid p _ (clock_frozenPC_valid p _ _ valid.2 valid.1) r c hc
    rw [pcValid_eq_of_data p _ _ (clock_blocks p _ _) (clock_archive p _ _)] at hc'
    exact pc v hv j hj.le c hc' hp

theorem clean_active_honest_proposal_head {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V]
    (p : Params) (E : Env V) (rho : Run V (sapc p)) (hΔ : E.Δ = p.Δ)
    (t₀ : Time) (hs : SleepyRegime (sapc p) E (sapcInterface p).toInterface rho t₀)
    (r : Slot) (hh : gateTime p r ≤ rho.horizon)
    (b : Block) (hb : HonestProposalAt E (sapcInterface p).toInterface rho (r + 1) b)
    (reader : V) (hr : reader ∈ rho.honest)
    (active : capBroken p (headState p rho (r + 1) reader) = false) :
    (headData p rho (r + 1) reader).target = b := by
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
  let source := proposalState p rho (r + 1)
  let target := headState p rho (r + 1) reader
  let cert := selectedPC p target (r + 1)
  let tree := activeVoterTree p target (r + 1) cert
  have headBound : voteTime p (r + 1) ≤ rho.horizon := by
    apply le_trans _ hh
    change 4 * p.Δ * ((r + 1 : Nat) : Time) + p.Δ ≤
      4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 6 * p.Δ
    push_cast
    linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have sync : E.t_GST ≤ freezeTime p r := by
    rw [hs.gst_zero]
    change 0 ≤ 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 3 * p.Δ
    nlinarith [p.deltaPos, Int.natCast_nonneg r]
  have syncP : E.t_GST ≤ proposalTime p (r + 1) := by
    rw [hs.gst_zero]
    change 0 ≤ 4 * p.Δ * ((r + 1 : Nat) : Time)
    nlinarith [p.deltaPos, Int.natCast_nonneg (r + 1)]
  have parent := clean_proposal_parent_ordinary p E rho hΔ t₀ hs r hh b hb
  have roots := (clean_roots_at_ordinary_proposal p E rho hΔ t₀ hs r hh b hb).2 reader hr
  rw [← parent] at roots
  have sourceActive := honest_proposal_active_source p E rho hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed
    hΔ hs.acceptedRelay (r + 1) syncP headBound hb.1 reader hr active
  have anchor : Block.Preceq
      (preliminaryAnchor (floor p target tree (GridCO.voterView p.engine target.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.voterSupportView p.engine target.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) cert) b.parent := by
    rw [← clean_honest_proposal_anchor_eq p E rho hΔ t₀ hs r headBound b hb reader hr active]
    have floorBelow : Block.Preceq
        (floor p source source.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView source.base (r + 1))
          (GridCO.proposerSupportView source.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) b.parent := by
      rw [parent]
      by_cases hg : floor p source source.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView source.base (r + 1))
          (GridCO.proposerSupportView source.base (r + 1)) (r + 1) = .genesis
      · rw [hg]; exact GridCO.genesis_prefix _
      · exact (floor_properties p source _ _ _ (r + 1) hg).2.1
    cases selected : source.bestPC with
    | none => exact floorBelow
    | some c =>
      have pcBelow := clean_proposal_PC_at_ordinary_walk p E rho hΔ t₀ hs r headBound
        b hb sourceActive c selected
      rw [← parent] at pcBelow
      simp only [preliminaryAnchor]
      split <;> assumption
  have mandatory : Block.Preceq (mandatoryRoot (GridCO.liveRoot target.base)
      (preliminaryAnchor (floor p target tree (GridCO.voterView p.engine target.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.voterSupportView p.engine target.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) cert)) b.parent := by
    unfold mandatoryRoot
    split <;> assumption
  have hslot := (honest_proposal_slot p E rho hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed
    (r + 1) b hb).2.2
  have sourceRoot : GridCO.RootInjectiveBelow source.base.blocks := by
    simpa only [source, proposalState, clock_blocks] using! time_input_rootInjectiveBelow p E rho
      hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed hs.rootInjective (proposalTime p (r + 1)) _
  have targetRoot : GridCO.RootInjectiveBelow target.base.blocks := by
    simpa only [target, headState, clock_blocks] using! time_input_rootInjectiveBelow p E rho
      hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed hs.rootInjective (voteTime p (r + 1)) reader
  have stored : b ∈ target.base.blocks := by
    have path := honest_proposal_path_before_head p E rho hs.execution hΔ hs.partialSynchrony
      (r + 1) b hb syncP headBound reader hr _ (le_refl _)
    simp only [target, headState, clock_blocks]
    cases b with
    | genesis => exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp path).1
    | node parent slot root =>
      exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp path).1).1
  have targetClosed : GridCO.StoredPrefixClosed target.base := by
    simpa only [target, headState, GridCO.StoredPrefixClosed, clock_blocks] using!
      (paths_at_fold p
        (rho.events.filter (fun e => decide (e.time < voteTime p (r + 1)))) reader).1
  have parentEq : b.parent? = some b.parent := by
    obtain ⟨_, shape, _⟩ := honest_proposal_views p E rho hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed
      (r + 1) b hb
    rw [shape]
    rfl
  have counts := honest_proposal_counts p E rho hs.execution hΔ hs.partialSynchrony
    hs.acceptedRelay r sync headBound b hb reader hr
  have covers := GridCO.ghost_adopts_of_eligible_proposal_transport p.engine source.base target.base
    (r + 1) b b.parent tree _ (activeVoterTree_subset p target (r + 1) cert)
    sourceRoot targetRoot (proposalState_paths p rho (r + 1)).1 parent.symm mandatory
    parentEq hslot
    (fun c hn hp => activeVoterTree_contains_plain p target (r + 1) cert
      (GridCO.proposal_path_mem_voterTree p.engine target.base (r + 1) _ b c _ _
        (honest_proposal_base_stored_at_head p E rho hs.execution hΔ hs.partialSynchrony
          (r + 1) b hb syncP headBound reader hr) rfl hslot targetClosed stored hn hp))
    (fun c hc he => clean_honest_proposal_eligible_reflects p E rho hΔ t₀ hs r headBound b hb
      reader hr c (activeVoterTree_subset p target (r + 1) cert hc) he)
    counts.1.symm (fun c _ _ => (counts.2.2 c).symm)
  have cover : Block.Preceq b (headData p rho (r + 1) reader).target := by
    simpa only [headData, headTarget, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false,
      decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, active, choice] using! covers
  have ordered := (paths_at_fold p
    (rho.events.filter (fun e => decide (e.time < voteTime p (r + 1)))) reader).2.2
      _ (headData_target_stored p rho (r + 1) reader)
  exact (GridCO.prefix_eq_of_slot_ge _ _ ordered cover (by
    rw [hslot]
    exact headData_target_slot p E rho hs.execution.toScheduleWellFormed (r + 1) reader)).symm

theorem honest_proposal_exists {V : Type} [DecidableEq V]
    {p : Params} {E : Env V} {rho : Run V (sapc p)}
    (hx : ExecutionValid (sapc p) E rho) (hΔ : E.Δ = p.Δ)
    (s : Slot) (hs : 0 < s) (hawake : HonestAwakeProposer E rho s)
    (hh : proposalTime p s ≤ rho.horizon) :
    ∃ b, HonestProposalAt E (sapcInterface p).toInterface rho s b := by
  have hpub : PublicTime E (proposalTime p s) := by
    refine ⟨4 * s, ?_⟩
    change 4 * p.Δ * (s : Time) = (4 * s : Nat) * E.Δ
    rw [hΔ]
    push_cast
    ring
  have ht : 0 ≤ proposalTime p s :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt p.deltaPos)) (Int.natCast_nonneg s)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp (hx.tick_total _ hawake.1 _ hpub ht hh)
  let st := clock p (Run.stateBefore (sapc p) rho i (rho.proposerOf s)) (proposalTime p s)
  let parent := choice p st st.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView st.base s)
    (GridCO.proposerSupportView st.base s) s st.bestPC
  let b := Block.node parent s 0
  let msg := Msg.proposal b (originalHeads st (GridCO.proposerView st.base s))
    (originalHeads st (GridCO.proposerSupportView st.base s)) st.bestPC
  have hp : propose p st s = some msg := by simp [propose, Nat.ne_of_gt hs, msg, b, parent]
  refine ⟨b, hawake.1, msg, rfl, i, hi, ?_⟩
  change _ ∈ Run.emittedAt (sapc p) E rho i (rho.proposerOf s) (proposalTime p s)
  simp only [Run.emittedAt, show E.awake (rho.proposerOf s) (proposalTime p s) = true from hawake.2,
    ↓reduceIte, List.mem_append]
  apply Or.inl
  apply Or.inr
  apply List.mem_filterMap.mpr
  refine ⟨s, ((sapc p).slotsAt_spec s _).mpr rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  change (propose p st s).map _ = _
  rw [hp]
  rfl

end AvailableChain.SAPC
end

    ∀ c ∈ GridCO.voterTree p.engine (headState p rho (r + 1) reader).base (r + 1),

    (hb : pathBefore before cut b = true) : pathBefore after cut b = true := by

      (ht : GridCO.stampBlock before.base b < cut) :

theorem recovery_honest_proposal_head_quorum {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype V]
    (p : Params) (E : Env V) (rho : Run V (sapc p)) (hΔ : E.Δ = p.Δ)
    (G : Time) (hG : 0 < G)
    (h : QuorumRecoveryRegime p G E rho)
    (boundary : Slot) (sources : RecoverySourcesSupported p rho boundary)
    (r : Slot) (start : voteTime p boundary ≤ proposalTime p (r + 1))
    (syncVote : E.t_GST ≤ voteTime p r) (hh : gateTime p r ≤ rho.horizon)
    (b : Block) (hb : HonestProposalAt E (sapcInterface p).toInterface rho (r + 1) b)
    (reader : V) (hr : reader ∈ rho.honest) :
    (headData p rho (r + 1) reader).target = b := by
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
  let source := proposalState p rho (r + 1)
  let target := headState p rho (r + 1) reader
  let cert := selectedPC p target (r + 1)
  let tree := activeVoterTree p target (r + 1) cert
  let F := floor p source source.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView source.base (r + 1))
    (GridCO.proposerSupportView source.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)
  let A := preliminaryAnchor F source.bestPC
  have cap := h.faultBound
  have active : capBroken p target = false := by
    dsimp only [target]
    rw [headState, capBroken_clock]
    exact capBroken_false_beforeTime p E rho h.execution cap reader _
  have sourceActive : capBroken p source = false := by
    dsimp only [source]
    rw [proposalState, capBroken_clock]
    exact capBroken_false_beforeTime p E rho h.execution cap _ _
  have headBound : voteTime p (r + 1) ≤ rho.horizon := by
    apply le_trans _ hh
    change 4 * p.Δ * ((r + 1 : Nat) : Time) + p.Δ ≤ 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 6 * p.Δ
    push_cast; linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have sync : E.t_GST ≤ freezeTime p r := by
    apply syncVote.trans
    change 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + p.Δ ≤ 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 3 * p.Δ
    linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have syncP : E.t_GST ≤ proposalTime p (r + 1) := by
    apply syncVote.trans
    change 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + p.Δ ≤ 4 * p.Δ * ((r + 1 : Nat) : Time)
    push_cast; linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have roots := recovery_roots_below_proposal_floor_quorum p E rho hΔ G hG h boundary sources
    r start syncVote hh b hb
  have sourceRootBelow : Block.Preceq (GridCO.liveRoot source.base) A :=
    GridCO.prefix_trans _ F A roots.1 (floor_below_preliminaryAnchor F source.bestPC)
  have targetRootBelow : Block.Preceq (GridCO.liveRoot target.base) A :=
    GridCO.prefix_trans _ F A (roots.2 reader hr) (floor_below_preliminaryAnchor F source.bestPC)
  have anchorEq : A = preliminaryAnchor
      (floor p target tree (GridCO.voterView p.engine target.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.voterSupportView p.engine target.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) cert :=
    recovery_proposal_anchor_eq_quorum p E rho hΔ G hG h r sync headBound b hb reader hr
  have parent : GridCO.ghost A source.base.blocks
      (GridCO.goldfishScore source.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView source.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.proposerSupportView source.base (r + 1)))
      (GridCO.goldfishEligible source.base.blocks (GridCO.proposerView source.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.proposerSupportView source.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) = b.parent := by
    obtain ⟨_, shape, _⟩ := honest_proposal_views p E rho h.execution.toScheduleWellFormed
      (r + 1) b hb
    conv_rhs => rw [shape]
    change _ = choice p source source.base.blocks _ _ (r + 1) source.bestPC
    simp only [choice, sourceActive, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    change _ = GridCO.ghost (mandatoryRoot (GridCO.liveRoot source.base) A) _ _ _
    rw [mandatoryRoot, ite_eq_left (show Block.preceq (GridCO.liveRoot source.base) A = true
      from sourceRootBelow)]
  have targetRootEq : mandatoryRoot (GridCO.liveRoot target.base)
      (preliminaryAnchor (floor p target tree (GridCO.voterView p.engine target.base (r + 1))
        (GridCO.voterSupportView p.engine target.base (r + 1)) (r + 1)) cert) = A := by
    rw [← anchorEq]
    exact ite_eq_left targetRootBelow
  have anchorParent : Block.Preceq A b.parent := by
    rw [← parent]
    exact GridCO.ghost_extends _ _ _ _
  have hslot := (honest_proposal_slot p E rho h.execution.toScheduleWellFormed
    (r + 1) b hb).2.2
  have sourceRoot : GridCO.RootInjectiveBelow source.base.blocks := by
    simpa only [source, proposalState, clock_blocks] using! time_input_rootInjectiveBelow p E rho
      h.execution.toScheduleWellFormed h.rootInjective (proposalTime p (r + 1)) _
  have targetRoot : GridCO.RootInjectiveBelow target.base.blocks := by

theorem timely_compatible_confirmation {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (p : Params)
    (E : Env V) (rho : Run V (sapc p)) (hs : ScheduleWellFormed E rho)
    (r : Slot) (source reader : V) (hsource : source ∈ rho.honest) (hr : reader ∈ rho.honest)
    (hrelay : RelayBy p rho (earlyTime p r) (gateTime p r)) (b c : Block)
    (hc : timelyCandidate p
      (Run.stateBeforeTime (sapc p) rho (earlyTime p r) source) r b = true)
    (hg : SA.confirmation p
      (Run.stateBeforeTime (sapc p) rho (gateTime p r) reader).base r = some c) :
    Block.Compatible c b := by
  let src := Run.stateBeforeTime (sapc p) rho (earlyTime p r) source
  have hparts := hc
  simp only [timelyCandidate, Bool.and_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_eq,
    bne_iff_ne, beq_iff_eq] at hparts
  have htime : earlyTime p r ≤ gateTime p r := by
    change 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 2 * p.Δ ≤ 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 6 * p.Δ
    linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have hb : b ∈ (Run.stateBeforeTime (sapc p) rho (gateTime p r) reader).base.blocks := by
    apply strict_block_relay p E rho hs _ _ htime hrelay source reader hsource hr b
    cases b with
    | genesis => exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hparts.1.2).1
    | node parent slot root =>
        exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp
          (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hparts.1.2).1).1
  apply raw_quorum_compatible_confirmation p _ r b c hb (le_of_eq hparts.1.1.2)
    (timelySeats p src r b) (timelySeats_quorum p src r b hc) _ hg
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨data, hm, ht, _⟩ := timelySeats_witness p src r b i hi
  have he : src = Run.readAt (sapc p) rho (earlyTime p r - 1) source := by
    simp only [src, Run.stateBeforeTime, Run.readAt, ← Int.le_sub_one_iff]
  rw [he] at hm
  have hz : 0 < gateTime p r := by
    change 0 < 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 6 * p.Δ
    nlinarith [p.deltaPos, Int.natCast_nonneg r]
  have hcut : gateTime p r ≤ proposalTime p (r + 2) := by
    change 4 * p.Δ * (r : Time) + 6 * p.Δ ≤ 4 * p.Δ * ((r + 2 : Nat) : Time)
    push_cast
    linarith [p.deltaPos]
  have h := read_head_base_relay p E rho hs (earlyTime p r - 1) (gateTime p r)
    ((Int.sub_lt_self _ (by decide : (0 : Int) < 1)).trans_le htime) hz r hcut
    (fun v hv j obj t hle hac w hw hn => hrelay v hv j obj t
      (le_of_lt (Int.le_sub_one_iff.mp hle)) hac w hw hn) source reader hsource hr i data hm
  simpa only [base_lateVotes_at_input p E rho hs, baseWire, baseHead, GridCO.fromHead, ht]
    using h

end AvailableChain.SAPC

  intro B
  induction B with
  | genesis =>
    intro C h
    cases C with
    | genesis => rfl
    | node q t y ts => exact absurd h.symm (root_ne_genesis_of_node q t y ts)
  | node p s x rs ih =>
    intro C h
    cases C with
    | genesis => exact absurd h (root_ne_genesis_of_node p s x rs)
    | node q t y ts =>
      simp only [root, nodeRoot, BlockId.mk.injEq, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨hpq, hst⟩ := epair_inj h
      obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := epair_inj hst
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := encFGBody_inj hb
      rw [ih (BlockId.ext hpq)]

new.name: AvailableChain.Witnesses.Regimes.rootInjective
new.source:
theorem rootInjective (E : Env (Fin 6)) : RootInjective E interface witnessRun :=
  by
    have scope : ∀ B, BlockInRun E interface witnessRun B →
        B = .genesis ∨ B = .node .genesis 2 (nodeRoot genesisRoot 2 0) 0 := by
      intro B hB
      rcases hB with hg | ⟨v, o, t, tip, _, htip, hp⟩
      · exact Or.inl hg
      · have he : tip = .node .genesis 2 (nodeRoot genesisRoot 2 0) 0 :=
          (Option.some.inj htip).symm
        rw [he] at hp
        simpa only [Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true,
          decide_eq_true_eq, or_comm] using hp
    intro B C hB hC hr
    rcases scope B hB with rfl | rfl <;> rcases scope C hC with rfl | rfl <;>
      first | rfl | simp [Block.root, nodeRoot, genesisRoot] at hr

new.name: AvailableChain.Witnesses.Sanity.exampleRootInjective
new.source:
theorem exampleRootInjective (D : Time) :
    RootInjective exampleEnv (interface 1) (exampleRun D) :=
  by
    have scope : ∀ B, BlockInRun exampleEnv (interface 1) (exampleRun D) B →
        B = .genesis ∨ ∃ s, B = proposed s := by
      intro B hB
      rcases hB with hg | ⟨v, o, t, tip, hobj, htip, hp⟩
      · exact Or.inl hg
      · have hpay : o.payload = tip := Option.some.inj htip
        rcases hobj with ⟨i, hi⟩ | ⟨i, _, ho⟩
        · exact False.elim (no_delivery D i v o t hi)
        · have hex : ∃ s, o.payload = proposed s := by
            have hv : v = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
            subst v
            by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t <;> by_cases hz : t.toNat = 0
            all_goals simp [Run.emittedAt, alwaysGenesis, exampleEnv, exampleRun, ht, hz] at ho
            all_goals first
              | exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil ho)
              | exact ⟨t.toNat, congrArg Signed.payload (List.mem_singleton.mp ho)⟩
          obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hex
          rw [← hpay, hs] at hp
          simp only [proposed, Block.Preceq, Block.preceq, Bool.or_eq_true,
            decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
          exact hp.elim (fun he => Or.inr ⟨s, he⟩) Or.inl
    intro B C hB hC hr
    rcases scope B hB with rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases scope C hC with rfl | ⟨t, rfl⟩
    · rfl
    · simp [proposed, Block.root, nodeRoot, genesisRoot] at hr
    · simp [proposed, Block.root, nodeRoot, genesisRoot] at hr
    · simp only [proposed, Block.root, nodeRoot, BlockId.mk.injEq,
        Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hr
      exact congrArg proposed (epair_inj (epair_inj hr).2).1
new.signature:
theorem exampleRootInjective (D : Time) :
    RootInjective exampleEnv (interface 1) (exampleRun D)
